Gnar.laning: Repeated Q casts will push the lane, so use Q less when you don’t know where the enemy jungler is and save Yone E Soul Unbound. If Gnar has pushed the lane, look for an angle to close in with a prepared tornado Q.
Gnar.phase: After Yone completes his first core item, take the initiative in fights using your attack speed and critical strike advantage. In the late game, keep track of Gnar’s transformation cycle and use the moment after he returns from Mega to Mini Gnar as an opportunity to fight.
Gnar.teamfight: Avoid positions with your back to a wall and narrow terrain so Mega Gnar R GNAR! can’t knock you into a wall. Engage with Yone E Soul Unbound active, and hit multiple enemies with Yone W Spirit Cleave to build a larger shield. Use Yone R Fate Sealed to pull enemies toward your team, and hold it if the angle would send you deep into the enemy team.
Gnar.watch: The boomerang from Gnar Q Boomerang Throw / Boulder Toss can also hit you on its return, so move out of its path. Mega Gnar R GNAR! stuns if it knocks you into a wall, so don’t fight with your back to a wall. When Gnar is close to transforming, avoid a head-on fight and create distance.

Gwen.build: Build magic resistance first against Gwen’s main damage. Armor helps against the physical damage from her basic attacks, but resistance cannot mitigate the center of Gwen Q Snip Snip!’s true damage. If Gwen’s healing could turn the duel, buy Executioner’s Calling between core items and upgrade it to Mortal Reminder.
Gwen.combo: Prepare tornado by hitting minions with Yone Q Mortal Steel, then, while Gwen E Skip ’n Slash is down, knock her up with tornado Q and trade in this order: two basic attacks → Yone W Spirit Cleave → basic attack. For an all-in, activate Yone E Soul Unbound first, then deal damage with tornado Q → basic attack → W → Yone R Fate Sealed → basic attack, and return with E. Keep an angle that lets you avoid the center of Gwen Q Snip Snip!.
Gwen.escape: Gwen’s mobility is Gwen E Skip ’n Slash, so the window to engage is right after you make her use it. Around many minions, Gwen E Skip ’n Slash can come back quickly, so draw her toward an area without minions or prepare Yone Q Mortal Steel’s knock-up before going in. When diving deep, activate Yone E Soul Unbound first to secure a way back.
Gwen.fight: Trade before Gwen stacks Q Snip Snip! or right after she uses Gwen E Skip ’n Slash. Prepare tornado with Yone Q Mortal Steel in advance, and when Gwen Q Snip Snip! comes out, sidestep while timing Yone W Spirit Cleave’s shield. Don’t stay within Gwen’s basic attack range long enough to give her a chance to heal.
Gwen.laning: When you don’t know where the enemy jungler is, don’t keep pushing the lane by farming with Q; save Yone E Soul Unbound. Take a short trade when Gwen pushes the lane and gives you an opening to engage with tornado Q, or when Gwen E Skip ’n Slash is down.
Gwen.phase: Once Yone has attack speed and critical strike items and completes his first core item, he can take the initiative in fights. The matchup’s late-game balance cannot be determined from the available information, so choose engages that let you return with Yone E Soul Unbound in team fights.
Gwen.teamfight: Engage the backline with Yone E Soul Unbound active, and hit multiple enemies with Yone W Spirit Cleave to build its shield. Use Yone R Fate Sealed to pull enemies toward your team, and avoid angles that pierce several enemies and leave you deep in their formation. Move away from the center of Gwen Q Snip Snip!, and if you need to target Gwen from outside Gwen W Hallowed Mist, wait for the mist to end.
Gwen.watch: The center of Gwen Q Snip Snip!’s cone deals true damage, so sidestep it. Gwen P A Thousand Cuts and Gwen R Needlework deal damage based on maximum health, and Gwen R Needlework also slows. You cannot target Gwen from outside Gwen W Hallowed Mist while she is inside it, so enter the mist or wait for it to end.

Hwei.build: Against Hwei’s magic damage, build magic resistance before armor. If you are often caught by roots, buy Quicksilver Sash earlier.
Hwei.combo: Before trading, hit minions with Yone Q Mortal Steel to prepare your tornado. Once Hwei E Subject: Torment is down, deal damage in this order: Yone E Soul Unbound → tornado Q Mortal Steel → basic attack → W Spirit Cleave → R Fate Sealed → basic attack, then recast E to return.
Hwei.escape: Hwei has no mobility, but while Hwei E Subject: Torment is available, Hwei can root or pull back Yone as he engages. Close the distance with Yone Q Mortal Steel or E Soul Unbound after that ability is down. Don’t use E Soul Unbound to dive deep into an area where E Subject: Torment is still available.
Hwei.fight: The window to engage is right after Hwei E Subject: Torment is used to poke or clear the wave. Stack Yone Q Mortal Steel on minions to prepare your tornado, then take a short trade after closing in, using Yone W Spirit Cleave’s shield to absorb key damage.
Hwei.laning: Repeatedly using Q pushes the lane, so when you don’t know where the enemy jungler is, use it less to pull the lane toward you and save Yone E Soul Unbound. Trade when Hwei pushes the lane and gives you an opening to engage with tornado Q.
Hwei.phase: The matchup’s late-game balance cannot be determined from the available information, so prioritize finding an engage angle and a way back in team fights.
Hwei.teamfight: After Hwei E Subject: Torment is down, activate Yone E Soul Unbound and engage the backline. Hit multiple champions with Yone W Spirit Cleave to build its shield, and use R Fate Sealed to pull enemies toward your team. Avoid angles that pierce multiple enemies with R and leave you deep in their formation; return with E.
Hwei.watch: If Hwei E Subject: Torment roots or pulls you in, you are likely to take follow-up damage, and you cannot return with Yone E Soul Unbound while crowd controlled. If you are hit by one of Hwei’s abilities, reposition immediately to avoid a second ability and the Hwei P Signature of the Visionary explosion.

Illaoi.build: Illaoi’s main damage is physical, and Illaoi W Harsh Lesson scales with maximum health, so build armor first and avoid choices that only add a large amount of health. If healing from Illaoi P Prophet of an Elder God could turn the duel, buy Executioner’s Calling between core items and upgrade it to Mortal Reminder.
Illaoi.combo: Hit minions with Yone Q Mortal Steel to prepare your tornado, then take a short trade in this order: knock her up with tornado Q → two basic attacks → Yone W Spirit Cleave → basic attack. If you have an opening to fight to the finish, deal damage in this order: Yone E Soul Unbound → tornado Q → basic attack → Yone W Spirit Cleave → Yone R Fate Sealed → basic attack, then recast Yone E Soul Unbound to return.
Illaoi.escape: Immediately after dodging Illaoi E Test of Spirit and making her use Illaoi W Harsh Lesson, you have a window to engage with Yone Q Mortal Steel or Yone E Soul Unbound. If Illaoi R Leap of Faith comes out, return with Yone E Soul Unbound to leave the tentacle area, and don’t dive deep where you can’t return.
Illaoi.fight: Dodge Illaoi E Test of Spirit, then close the distance immediately after making her use Illaoi W Harsh Lesson. Hit minions with Yone Q Mortal Steel to prepare your tornado, then take a short trade. If Illaoi uses R Leap of Faith, don’t fight for long in the tentacle area.
Illaoi.laning: Keep the wave from being pulled near a wall, and last-hit outside Illaoi E Test of Spirit range. When you don’t know where the enemy jungler is, don’t keep pushing the lane with Yone Q Mortal Steel; save Yone E Soul Unbound.
Illaoi.phase: The late-game one-on-one matchup cannot be determined from the available information, so keep avoiding the tentacle area while Illaoi R Leap of Faith is active.
Illaoi.teamfight: Don’t group with allies in front of Illaoi R Leap of Faith; if she uses it, spread out and leave her without a target to hit. Engage with Yone E Soul Unbound active and hit multiple enemies with Yone W Spirit Cleave to build its shield. Use Yone R Fate Sealed to pull enemies toward your team, and hold it if the angle would leave you deep in their formation.
Illaoi.watch: Being hit by Illaoi E Test of Spirit puts you at a disadvantage due to its slow and mark, so stand outside its range when last-hitting and dodge it if it comes your way. Illaoi R Leap of Faith spawns more tentacles the more champions it hits, so when she uses her ultimate, back away instead of fighting near the tentacles.

Jax.build: Jax deals a mix of physical and magic damage, so don’t focus solely on armor or magic resistance.
Jax.combo: If Jax E Counter Strike is down and your tornado is ready, deal damage in this order: Yone E Soul Unbound → Yone Q Mortal Steel tornado → basic attack → Yone W Spirit Cleave → Yone R Fate Sealed → basic attack. When you’re done, recast Yone E Soul Unbound to return. If Counter Strike is active, hold off on basic attacks and engaging with tornado Q.
Jax.escape: Once the stun from Jax E Counter Strike is down, the moment after Jax uses Jax Q Leap Strike is your window to engage. Close the distance with Yone Q Mortal Steel tornado or Yone E Soul Unbound, and if you went in with E, return after dealing damage.
Jax.fight: Start trading after Jax E Counter Strike is down. Stack Yone Q Mortal Steel on minions in advance, then, while Counter Strike is unavailable, knock him up with tornado Q, land basic attacks and Yone W Spirit Cleave, and back away.
Jax.laning: If you don’t know where the enemy jungler is, don’t push the lane too hard with Q, and save Yone E Soul Unbound. Once Jax E Counter Strike is down, trade or pressure him with your jungler.
Jax.phase: Yone can also take the initiative in fights once he has attack speed and critical strike and completes his first core item.
Jax.teamfight: If Jax jumps on you and activates Jax E Counter Strike, create distance. Once the area stun ends, control him with Yone Q Mortal Steel and Yone R Fate Sealed. When engaging the backline, activate Yone E Soul Unbound first, then hit multiple enemies with Yone W Spirit Cleave to build its shield. Avoid angles where Yone R Fate Sealed pierces the enemy group and leaves you deep in their formation.
Jax.watch: Jax can engage with Jax Q Leap Strike and reactivate Counter Strike, so save Yone E Soul Unbound or tornado Q to dodge the stun.

Jayce.build: Prioritize completing Yone’s first core item with attack speed and critical strike. If building resistance against the damage from Jayce W Lightning Field and Jayce E Thundering Blow, prioritize magic resistance. Magic resistance cannot mitigate the physical damage from Jayce Q Shock Blast.
Jayce.combo: Hit minions with Yone Q Mortal Steel to prepare your tornado. For an all-in, deal damage in this order: Yone E Soul Unbound → tornado Q → basic attack → Yone W Spirit Cleave → Yone R Fate Sealed → basic attack. Then recast E to return to your original position.
Jayce.escape: The moment after making Jayce use the leap from Jayce Q To the Skies! is an opportunity to close the distance with Yone Q Mortal Steel, Yone E Soul Unbound, or Yone R Fate Sealed. If Jayce E Thundering Blow’s knockback is still available, check whether he has used it, as he can push you away after you engage.
Jayce.fight: Hit minions with Yone Q Mortal Steel to prepare your tornado, then start trading. Knock Jayce up with tornado Q, land two basic attacks and Yone W Spirit Cleave, then back away. If Jayce’s knockback is still available, carefully choose fights that require committing deep into close range.
Jayce.laning: While Jayce is strong early, farm with Yone Q Mortal Steel and avoid risky engages. When Jayce is in cannon form, farm while moving side to side to dodge Jayce Q Shock Blast. When you don’t know where the jungler is, use Q less so the lane doesn’t push, and save Yone E Soul Unbound.
Jayce.phase: Yone can take the initiative in fights once he has attack speed and critical strike and completes his first core item. The matchup’s late-game balance cannot be determined from the available information.
Jayce.teamfight: Engage when Jayce Q To the Skies!’s leap is down. Go in with Yone E Soul Unbound active, and hit multiple enemies with Yone W Spirit Cleave to build its shield. Use Yone R Fate Sealed to pull enemies toward your team, and avoid a path that leaves you deep in their formation.
Jayce.watch: When you see Jayce E Acceleration Gate, Jayce Q Shock Blast may follow, so sidestep out of its straight path. When Jayce is in hammer form, watch for the leap from Jayce Q To the Skies! and the knockback from Jayce E Thundering Blow. If you can’t dodge key damage, time Yone W Spirit Cleave’s shield to absorb it.

Karma.build: Consider magic resistance first against Karma’s main damage from Karma Q Inner Flame and Karma W Focused Resolve. If Karma W Focused Resolve’s root often prevents you from returning with Yone E Soul Unbound, buy Quicksilver Sash earlier. If the healing from Karma W Focused Resolve empowered by Karma R Mantra could turn the duel, fit Executioner’s Calling between core items.
Karma.combo: After Karma W Focused Resolve is down, hit minions with Yone Q Mortal Steel to prepare your tornado. For a short trade, knock her up with tornado Q, then land two basic attacks, Yone W Spirit Cleave, and a basic attack before backing away. For an all-in, activate Yone E Soul Unbound first, then land tornado Q, a basic attack, W, Yone R Fate Sealed, and a basic attack, and recast E.
Karma.escape: Use the window while Karma W Focused Resolve is down to close the distance with Yone E Soul Unbound and tornado Q. If Karma W Focused Resolve is tethered to you, create distance and break it before you are rooted; don’t rely on returning with Yone E Soul Unbound while still tethered.
Karma.fight: Stack Yone Q Mortal Steel on minions, but don’t engage first with tornado Q while Karma W Focused Resolve is available. Once Karma W Focused Resolve is down, look for a chance to engage with Yone E Soul Unbound, deal damage, and return. Don’t rush burst damage right after Karma E Inspire’s shield comes up.
Karma.laning: When Karma Q Inner Flame comes toward you, time Yone W Spirit Cleave’s shield to absorb it, and walk out of the area left by Q empowered by Karma R Mantra. Don’t keep pushing the wave with Yone Q Mortal Steel; when you don’t know where the enemy jungler is, pull the lane toward you and save Yone E Soul Unbound.
Karma.phase: The matchup’s late-game balance cannot be determined from the available information, so in team fights, check Karma’s root and shields before engaging.
Karma.teamfight: Don’t dive deep first while Karma W Focused Resolve is available; create distance and an opportunity for her to use it. If Karma’s nearby allies are shielded by Karma E Inspire empowered by Karma R Mantra, engage after the shield expires. Harass the backline with Yone E Soul Unbound active, hit multiple enemies with Yone W Spirit Cleave to build its shield, and use Yone R Fate Sealed to pull enemies toward your team.
Karma.watch: If Karma Q Inner Flame hits you for free, Karma P Gathering Fire brings Karma R Mantra back sooner, so dodge by moving behind minions or outside its range. If you are hit by Karma Q Inner Flame empowered by Karma R Mantra, immediately leave the remaining fire zone. While Karma W Focused Resolve is tethered to you, create distance to avoid the root, and don’t engage with Yone E Soul Unbound where you could be rooted.

Kassadin.build: Prioritize attack speed and critical strike to be ready to fight as soon as you complete your first core item. Build magic resistance rather than armor to withstand Kassadin’s main ability damage. Kassadin W Nether Blade restores mana, not health, so don’t buy items for healing reduction.
Kassadin.combo: Hit minions with Yone Q Mortal Steel to prepare your tornado. For a short trade, knock Kassadin up with tornado Q, then use two basic attacks, Yone W Spirit Cleave, and a basic attack. To go for a kill, activate Yone E Soul Unbound first, then use tornado Q, a basic attack, W, Yone R Fate Sealed, and a basic attack before returning with E. If an ally immobilizes Kassadin, follow up with R first and hold tornado Q to give Kassadin less time to use Kassadin R Riftwalk.
Kassadin.escape: When using Yone E Soul Unbound, engage with your return spot in mind.
Kassadin.fight: When Kassadin R Riftwalk is down or not yet available, activate Yone E Soul Unbound first and engage so the damage from the fight is included in the bonus damage when you return.
Kassadin.laning: When you can push the wave in, pressure with your jungler. If you don’t know where the enemy jungler is, use Q less to pull the wave toward you and save Yone E Soul Unbound. Using abilities unnecessarily near Kassadin speeds up Kassadin E Force Pulse’s cooldown, so clear the wave from outside its range whenever possible.
Kassadin.phase: In mid game, Yone can take the initiative and start fights as soon as his first core item grants attack speed and critical strike. In late game, Kassadin can use R Riftwalk to enter the backline and escape, so don’t stand alone within its range.
Kassadin.teamfight: Aim to disrupt the backline with Yone E Soul Unbound active and return alive. Use Yone W Spirit Cleave to clip multiple enemies and build a larger shield, and angle Yone R Fate Sealed to pull enemies toward your team. Since Kassadin can use R Riftwalk to enter the backline, look for a chance to follow an ally’s immobilization with R and tornado Q to lock him down.
Kassadin.watch: Kassadin Q Null Sphere’s shield absorbs magic damage, so take trades that also count on Yone W Spirit Cleave’s magic damage after Kassadin has used Q. Watch out for the slow from Kassadin E Force Pulse, and don’t chase too deep relying only on Yone’s dash while Kassadin R Riftwalk is available.

Kayle.build: Prioritize completing your first core item with attack speed and critical strike to improve Yone’s trading. Build magic resistance rather than armor against Kayle’s damage, but avoid a direct hit from Kayle Q Radiant Blast because it reduces the effectiveness of that resistance. If the healing from Kayle W Celestial Blessing can swing the duel, buy Executioner’s Calling between core items and upgrade it to Mortal Reminder.
Kayle.combo: For an all-in, activate Yone E Soul Unbound first, then engage with prepared Yone Q Mortal Steel tornado and deal damage in this order: basic attack → Yone W Spirit Cleave → Yone R Fate Sealed → basic attack. If Kayle R Divine Judgment is active, don’t focus your damage during its duration; lock her down with Yone Q Mortal Steel or Yone R Fate Sealed, then attack again when her invulnerability ends. After dealing damage, recast Yone E Soul Unbound to return to your starting spot.
Kayle.escape: Kayle has no innate mobility, so a good time to engage is after Kayle Q Radiant Blast misses or she uses the movement speed from Kayle W Celestial Blessing. If Kayle R Divine Judgment is also down, it’s a good time to start a full fight. When engaging, use Yone E Soul Unbound to secure a return spot, and knock Kayle up to leave her less room to escape with W.
Kayle.fight: Just before a fight, hit a minion with Yone Q Mortal Steel to prepare tornado. For a short trade, knock Kayle up, then use two basic attacks and Yone W Spirit Cleave. Time Yone W Spirit Cleave’s shield to absorb Kayle’s key attack.
Kayle.laning: Repeatedly using Q pushes the wave, so when you don’t know where the enemy jungler is, use it less to pull the wave toward you and save Yone E Soul Unbound. If Kayle pushes the wave, look for a chance to close in with prepared tornado Q, and call your jungler for a gank.
Kayle.teamfight: Create a path to reach Kayle directly from a flank or outside vision, and coordinate your engage timing with your team’s crowd control. Before going deep, activate Yone E Soul Unbound, and hit multiple enemies with Yone W Spirit Cleave to build a larger shield. Angle Yone R Fate Sealed to pull Kayle toward your team, and avoid angles that carry you through multiple enemies and leave you deep in their formation.
Kayle.watch: Kayle Q Radiant Blast slows and reduces armor and magic resistance, so avoid taking a direct hit. Kayle E Starfire Spellblade deals damage based on missing health, so be especially careful when your health is low. When Kayle R Divine Judgment is active, don’t pour in damage; knock her up with Yone Q Mortal Steel or Yone R Fate Sealed to wait out her invulnerability.

Kennen.build: Prioritize completing your first core item with attack speed and critical strike. Build magic resistance rather than armor against Kennen’s damage.
Kennen.combo: Then recast Yone E Soul Unbound to return to your starting spot.
Kennen.escape: The moment Kennen E Lightning Rush is down is Yone’s chance to engage. If Kennen P Mark of the Storm has two stacks or a stun threat remains, don’t use Yone E Soul Unbound to go deep; wait for the stacks to disappear before engaging.
Kennen.fight: Start fights when Kennen E Lightning Rush is down and you have no stun marks stacked. Hit a minion with Yone Q Mortal Steel to prepare tornado, then close in. Use Yone W Spirit Cleave for its shield when Kennen’s key ability comes at you.
Kennen.laning: If you don’t know where the enemy jungler is, manage your Q use so you don’t push the wave, and save Yone E Soul Unbound. When Kennen has pushed the wave, look for an angle to close in with tornado Q.
Kennen.phase: Yone can take the initiative and fight after completing his first core item with attack speed and critical strike. In late game, don’t assume a one-sided advantage; fight while avoiding Kennen’s stun and area engage.
Kennen.teamfight: Spread out from your team so you don’t all get caught in Kennen R Slicing Maelstrom’s area stun, and use vision to check where you can engage. Go deep only with Yone E Soul Unbound active, and hit multiple enemies with Yone W Spirit Cleave to build a larger shield. Angle Yone R Fate Sealed to pull enemies toward your team, and hold it if the path would leave you deep in the enemy formation.
Kennen.watch: Kennen’s P Mark of the Storm stuns after three stacks, so when you have two, back off and wait for them to disappear. Dodge Kennen Q Thundering Shuriken from behind minions, and don’t enter the area where Kennen R Slicing Maelstrom is active.

Kled.build: Yone gets strong starting with his first core item with attack speed and critical strike, so prioritize it. Build armor first for resistance against Kled Q Bear Trap on a Rope, W Violent Tendencies, and E Jousting, which deal his main damage. Kled W Violent Tendencies and R Chaaaaaaaarge!!! deal max-health-based damage, so avoid options that only add a large amount of health.
Kled.combo: If Kled’s pull and mobility are down, activate Yone E Soul Unbound first and knock him up with prepared Yone Q Mortal Steel tornado. Follow with a basic attack, Yone W Spirit Cleave, Yone R Fate Sealed, and a basic attack, then recast E to return. For a short trade, close in with tornado Q, knock him up, use two basic attacks, W, and a basic attack, then back off.
Kled.escape: Your chance to engage comes after dodging Kled Q Bear Trap on a Rope’s pull and once Kled E Jousting and R Chaaaaaaaarge!!! are down. If only E is down, he can still escape with R, so check for his remaining mobility too. When engaging with Yone E Soul Unbound, avoid situations where Kled’s crowd control could prevent you from returning.
Kled.fight: Hit a minion with Yone Q Mortal Steel to prepare tornado, but don’t dash in first while Kled Q Bear Trap on a Rope can still pull you. When Kled W Violent Tendencies starts, absorb damage with Yone W Spirit Cleave’s shield, then back off before taking the fourth basic attack and re-engage. Once both Kled E Jousting and R Chaaaaaaaarge!!! are down, close the distance with Yone Q Mortal Steel and E Soul Unbound.
Kled.laning: When you don’t know where the enemy jungler is, use Q less and save Yone E Soul Unbound so you don’t keep pushing the wave. If you dismount Kled from Skaarl, don’t give him room to farm and build courage to remount.
Kled.phase: Yone can fight aggressively starting with his first core item with attack speed and critical strike. Kled gets weaker after laning phase and mid game, so avoid giving him an early lead and play for late game.
Kled.teamfight: Use vision to check the direction of Kled R Chaaaaaaaarge!!!, and don’t break formation if your frontline can be its first target. Yone should enter the backline with E Soul Unbound active, hit multiple enemies with Yone W Spirit Cleave to build a larger shield, then return. Angle Yone R Fate Sealed to pull enemies toward your team, and avoid paths that leave you deep in the enemy formation.
Kled.watch: If Kled Q Bear Trap on a Rope catches you, create distance before it pulls you in. Kled W Violent Tendencies deals a burst of max-health-based damage on its fourth basic attack, so once the attacks start, don’t stay close enough to take all four. Kled R Chaaaaaaaarge!!! can engage from far away, so maintain vision on the flanks.

KSante.build: Complete your first core item with attack speed and critical strike earlier to improve Yone W Spirit Cleave’s shield use and your trading power. Build armor against K’Sante’s physical damage, and consider health if you need to withstand the true damage from K’Sante W Path Maker. If crowd control often prevents you from returning with Yone E Soul Unbound, buy Quicksilver Sash earlier.
KSante.combo: Once K’Sante’s immobilizing ability is down, activate Yone E Soul Unbound first, then engage by knocking him up with your prepared Yone Q Mortal Steel tornado. Land a basic attack and time Yone W Spirit Cleave to gain a shield against K’Sante’s key attack, then add damage with Yone R Fate Sealed and a basic attack. After dealing damage, recast Yone E Soul Unbound to return.
KSante.escape: Look for an opening once K’Sante W Path Maker’s dash and crowd control are down, as well as K’Sante E Footwork. If K’Sante R All Out is also unavailable, close the distance with Yone Q Mortal Steel, E Soul Unbound, or R Fate Sealed. Don’t use Yone E Soul Unbound to dive deep while K’Sante’s immobilizing ability is available.
KSante.fight: While K’Sante W Path Maker is charging, don’t commit your damage; sidestep, then fight. When K’Sante R All Out is active, his maximum health and resistances are lower, so focus him with your team, but don’t face his increased damage and lifesteal alone.
KSante.laning: Before a fight, hit minions with Yone Q Mortal Steel to prepare your tornado, and check K’Sante Q Ntofo Strikes’ stacks. When you don’t know where the enemy jungler is, manage Q use so you don’t push the wave, and save Yone E Soul Unbound.
KSante.phase: Once K’Sante has stacked defensive items, it becomes difficult to turn the lane around, but Yone can take the initiative in fights after completing his first core item with attack speed and critical strike. The available information does not establish a one-sided late-game advantage, so look for openings when K’Sante’s crowd control and mobility are down.
KSante.teamfight: Harass the backline with Yone E Soul Unbound active, and hit multiple enemies with Yone W Spirit Cleave to build its shield. Use Yone R Fate Sealed to pull enemies toward your team, and hold it if the path would leave you deep in their formation. Focus K’Sante with your team while K’Sante R All Out is active. If the fight will last a while, make sure at least one member of your team has a source of Grievous Wounds.
KSante.watch: When K’Sante has stacked K’Sante Q Ntofo Strikes, his next attack pulls and stuns, so check his stacks and back out of range. While K’Sante W Path Maker is charging, he has unstoppable status and damage reduction, so don’t use Yone Q Mortal Steel tornado; sidestep the charge path. Keep terrain from being directly behind you so K’Sante R All Out cannot knock you over a wall.

Leblanc.build: Treat your first core item as the point when you secure attack speed and critical strike. Build magic resistance rather than armor against the damage from LeBlanc Q Sigil of Malice, W Distortion, and E Ethereal Chains. If the composition puts you at high risk of being rooted and unable to return with Yone E Soul Unbound, buy Quicksilver Sash earlier.
Leblanc.combo: Hit a minion with Yone Q Mortal Steel to prepare tornado. When LeBlanc E Ethereal Chains is down and LeBlanc W Distortion’s return has also been used, deal damage in this order: Yone E Soul Unbound → tornado Q → basic attack → W Spirit Cleave → R Fate Sealed → basic attack, then recast E to return. For a short trade, knock her up with tornado Q, then use only two basic attacks → W → basic attack before backing off.
Leblanc.escape: Right after LeBlanc W Distortion is a chance to close the distance, but account for the possibility that she can return to that spot while the return is available. Once the return expires or is used and LeBlanc E Ethereal Chains is down, engage with Yone Q Mortal Steel, E Soul Unbound, or R Fate Sealed. If the chain hits you, use a mobility ability to get out of chain range instead of waiting for the root.
Leblanc.fight: Hit a minion with Yone Q Mortal Steel to prepare tornado, but don’t dive in with tornado Q or Yone E Soul Unbound while LeBlanc E Ethereal Chains is available. Engage after LeBlanc W Distortion’s return expires or is used, and her chain is down. Use Yone W Spirit Cleave’s shield to absorb LeBlanc’s key abilities as they come at you.
Leblanc.laning: Repeatedly using Q pushes the wave, so when you don’t know where the enemy jungler is, use it less to pull the wave toward you and save Yone E Soul Unbound. Alert your team immediately if LeBlanc disappears from vision.
Leblanc.phase: Once your first core item grants attack speed and critical strike, take the initiative and fight. In late game, check whether LeBlanc W Distortion and E Ethereal Chains are available before engaging, and secure a return spot with Yone E Soul Unbound.
Leblanc.teamfight: Go deep only with Yone E Soul Unbound active, disrupt the enemy backline, and return alive. Use Yone W Spirit Cleave to clip multiple enemies and build a larger shield. Angle Yone R Fate Sealed to pull enemies toward your team, and hold it if the angle would leave you deep in the enemy formation.
Leblanc.watch: If LeBlanc Q Sigil of Malice’s mark remains, her next ability deals increased damage, so back away and wait for it to disappear. If LeBlanc E Ethereal Chains hits you, use Yone Q Mortal Steel, E Soul Unbound, or R Fate Sealed to get out of chain range before the root takes hold. LeBlanc P Mirror Image’s clone can’t deal damage, so identify which one is actually attacking before using abilities.

Lissandra.build: When preparing your first core item, prioritize attack speed and critical strike. Build magic resistance rather than armor against Lissandra’s main damage. If roots and stuns can prevent you from escaping, buy Quicksilver Sash earlier.
Lissandra.combo: If Lissandra W Ring of Frost is down, activate Yone E Soul Unbound first, knock her up with prepared Yone Q Mortal Steel tornado, then deal damage in this order: basic attack → Yone W Spirit Cleave → Yone R Fate Sealed → basic attack. After dealing damage, recast Yone E Soul Unbound to return to your starting spot. If Lissandra R Frozen Tomb’s damage immunity is still active, don’t use all your finishing damage at once.
Lissandra.escape: The window to engage is immediately after Lissandra uses W Ring of Frost or immediately after she has fully spent E Glacial Path. As Lissandra E Glacial Path’s claw travels, knock her up with Yone Q Mortal Steel tornado to prevent her from reactivating it to move. Don’t go deep with Yone E Soul Unbound where Lissandra W Ring of Frost or R Frozen Tomb is available, since they can prevent you from returning.
Lissandra.fight: Hit a minion with Yone Q Mortal Steel to prepare tornado, and trade after Lissandra W Ring of Frost is down. If Lissandra has also used E Glacial Path, close the distance with Yone Q Mortal Steel and Yone E Soul Unbound. As you engage, time Yone W Spirit Cleave’s shield to absorb Lissandra Q Ice Shard or W Ring of Frost if they come at you.
Lissandra.laning: When you don’t know where the enemy jungler is, don’t keep pushing the wave with Q, and save Yone E Soul Unbound. Look for an angle to trade with tornado Q when Lissandra has pushed the wave or just used Lissandra W Ring of Frost on it.
Lissandra.phase: The available information isn’t enough to determine who has the advantage in late game; in teamfights, engage based on whether Lissandra has used her mobility and crowd control.
Lissandra.teamfight: After confirming Lissandra E Glacial Path is down, activate Yone E Soul Unbound and enter the backline. Hit multiple enemies with Yone W Spirit Cleave to build a larger shield, and angle Yone R Fate Sealed to pull enemies toward your team. Don’t pour finishing damage into Lissandra R Frozen Tomb’s damage immunity; return with Yone E Soul Unbound when you can make it back alive.
Lissandra.watch: Lissandra Q Ice Shard pierces after hitting a minion, so don’t stand in line with allied minions. Don’t go deep with Yone E Soul Unbound while Lissandra W Ring of Frost’s root and Lissandra R Frozen Tomb’s stun are available. If Lissandra casts R Frozen Tomb on herself, she becomes immune to damage, so stagger your finishing damage to land immediately after the immunity ends.

Lux.build: If abilities that bind Yone, such as Lux Q Light Binding, pose a threat, buy Quicksilver Sash earlier. Build magic resistance rather than armor against Lux’s damage. After your first core item, Yone’s strength grows with attack speed and critical strike.
Lux.combo: Hit a minion with Yone Q Mortal Steel to prepare tornado, then dodge Lux Q Light Binding. For a short trade, knock her up with tornado Q, then use two basic attacks, Yone W Spirit Cleave, and a basic attack before backing off. For an all-in, activate Yone E Soul Unbound first, then use tornado Q, a basic attack, W, Yone R Fate Sealed, and a basic attack before recasting E to return.
Lux.escape: Right after Lux Q Light Binding misses is your chance to engage. Lux has no mobility, so after dodging the binding, close the distance with Yone Q Mortal Steel or E Soul Unbound.
Lux.fight: Hit a minion with Yone Q Mortal Steel to prepare tornado, but don’t dash in first while Lux Q Light Binding is available. Lux has no mobility, so once you close the distance, deal damage with basic attacks and Yone W Spirit Cleave.
Lux.laning: Lux Q Light Binding can hit the first two targets in its path, so don’t stand in line with your allies. When you don’t know where the enemy jungler is, manage your Q use so you don’t push the wave, and save Yone E Soul Unbound.
Lux.phase: Yone can take the initiative and fight as soon as he completes his first core item with attack speed and critical strike. The available information isn’t enough to determine who has the advantage in late game, so fight from an angle where you can dodge the binding and return alive.
Lux.teamfight: Approach from different directions and spread out from your team so you don’t all get caught by Lux E Lucent Singularity. Engage with Yone E Soul Unbound active, and hit multiple enemies with Yone W Spirit Cleave to build a larger shield. Angle Yone R Fate Sealed to pull enemies toward your team, and hold it if the path through them would leave you deep in the enemy formation.
Lux.watch: If Lux Q Light Binding roots you, you’re likely to get hit by follow-up abilities, so bait it out and dodge before engaging. Leave the area where Lux E Lucent Singularity is placed, and sidestep when you see the aim line for Lux R Final Spark. If Lux’s abilities hit you, create distance so she can’t trigger Lux P Illumination’s mark with a basic attack.

Malphite.build: Build magic resistance against the damage from Malphite Q Seismic Shard, E Ground Slam, and R Unstoppable Force. Against Malphite, who stacks armor, also make use of Yone W Spirit Cleave’s max-health-based damage and magic damage.
Malphite.combo: After breaking Malphite P Granite Shield, hit a minion with Yone Q Mortal Steel to prepare tornado. For a short trade, knock him up with tornado Q, then use two basic attacks, Yone W Spirit Cleave, and a basic attack before backing off. For an all-in while Malphite R Unstoppable Force is down, activate Yone E Soul Unbound first, then use tornado Q, a basic attack, W, Yone R Fate Sealed, and a basic attack before returning with E.
Malphite.escape: When Malphite R Unstoppable Force is available, don’t go deep because you can’t immediately return with Yone E Soul Unbound if you’re knocked up.
Malphite.fight: Break Malphite P Granite Shield first, then start trading to chip away at his actual health. Hit a minion with Yone Q Mortal Steel to prepare tornado, then engage when you aren’t slowed by Malphite Q Seismic Shard. If Malphite R Unstoppable Force is down, go in with Yone E Soul Unbound, deal damage, and return.
Malphite.laning: However, if you’ve been using Yone Q Mortal Steel to keep pushing the wave, save Yone E Soul Unbound when you don’t know where the enemy jungler is.
Malphite.teamfight: Spread out from your allies so Malphite R Unstoppable Force doesn’t knock up several of you at once, then counterattack as soon as R is down. Disrupt the backline with Yone E Soul Unbound active, and hit multiple enemies with Yone W Spirit Cleave to build a larger shield. Angle Yone R Fate Sealed to pull enemies toward your team, and hold it if the angle would leave you deep in the enemy formation.
Malphite.watch: Malphite R Unstoppable Force is an unstoppable dash, so don’t try to interrupt it with the knock-up from Yone Q Mortal Steel. When you can’t see Malphite, don’t stand clustered with your allies near walls or brush, and don’t start a trade immediately after being slowed by Malphite Q Seismic Shard.

Mel.build: Get attack speed and critical strike chance in your first core item to reach Yone’s power spike sooner. Build magic resistance rather than armor against the damage from Mel P Searing Brilliance, Q Radiant Volley, and E Solar Snare. If Mel E Solar Snare’s root often keeps you from returning with Yone E Soul Unbound, buy Quicksilver Sash earlier.
Mel.combo: Hit minions with Yone Q Mortal Steel to prepare a tornado. Once Mel E Solar Snare is down, knock her up with tornado Q and trade with two basic attacks → Yone W Spirit Cleave → basic attack. For an all-in, first activate Yone E Soul Unbound from a safe position, then deal damage with tornado Q → basic attack → W → Yone R Fate Sealed → basic attack before returning with E.
Mel.escape: Mel has no mobility to create distance, so the moment after Mel E Solar Snare and W Rebuttal are down is your chance to engage. If you dive in with Yone E Soul Unbound while the root is still available, you may be unable to return, so wait for that opening. When Mel E Solar Snare comes toward you, sidestep away from its center.
Mel.fight: Hit minions with Yone Q Mortal Steel to prepare a tornado, then close the gap after Mel E Solar Snare is down. Use Yone W Spirit Cleave’s shield to absorb Mel’s key abilities as they come in. When Mel W Rebuttal is down, use your prepared tornado Q and a basic attack for a short trade.
Mel.laning: Then pressure Mel to slow her growth from Mel R Golden Eclipse, but when you don’t know where the jungler is, don’t keep pushing the lane with Q, and save Yone E Soul Unbound. If Mel has pushed the lane, look for an opening to engage with tornado Q.
Mel.phase: After building attack speed and critical strike chance in your first core item, take the initiative and fight to slow Mel’s growth. Pressure her early because Mel R Golden Eclipse makes her stronger over time, putting you at a disadvantage later.
Mel.teamfight: Activate Yone E Soul Unbound and dive into the backline, then hit multiple enemies with Yone W Spirit Cleave to build a larger shield. Use Yone R Fate Sealed from an angle that pulls enemies toward your team, and avoid angles that carry you through several enemies and leave you deep in their formation. If Mel E Solar Snare is still available, its root may prevent your E return, so wait to engage.
Mel.watch: Mel E Solar Snare roots you if it hits at the center, and Mel Q Radiant Volley can follow, so sidestep it. Don’t rush your main abilities when Mel looks about to activate W Rebuttal. If Mel has hit you several times, back off and watch for the execute from Mel P Searing Brilliance, even if you still have health and a shield.

Mordekaiser.build: Prioritize magic resistance against the magic damage from Mordekaiser P Darkness Rise, Q Obliterate, and E Death’s Grasp. Then look to fight aggressively from your first core item, once you have attack speed and critical strike chance. If Mordekaiser W Indestructible’s healing can turn the duel, buy Executioner’s Calling between core items and upgrade it to Mortal Reminder.
Mordekaiser.combo: Hit minions with Yone Q Mortal Steel to prepare a tornado. When Mordekaiser E Death’s Grasp is down and you have an opening to all-in, deal damage with Yone E Soul Unbound → tornado Q → basic attack → Yone W Spirit Cleave → Yone R Fate Sealed → basic attack, then recast E to return. If Mordekaiser W Indestructible’s shield has just come up, delay focusing your damage.
Mordekaiser.escape: Mordekaiser has no mobility, so when Mordekaiser E Death’s Grasp is down, you can close the gap with Yone Q Mortal Steel, E Soul Unbound, and R Fate Sealed. If Mordekaiser R Realm of Death is ready, avoid engaging by entering its range alone.
Mordekaiser.fight: When Mordekaiser E Death’s Grasp is down, close in with a prepared Yone Q Mortal Steel tornado. In short trades, back off before Mordekaiser P Darkness Rise activates, and don’t focus your damage right after Mordekaiser W Indestructible’s shield comes up.
Mordekaiser.laning: Repeated Q use pushes the lane, so when you don’t know where the enemy jungler is, use it less to keep the wave near your side and save Yone E Soul Unbound. If the enemy has pushed the lane and Mordekaiser E Death’s Grasp is down, look to trade with a prepared tornado Q.
Mordekaiser.phase: The available information isn’t enough to determine who has the advantage late game, so keep positioned to avoid being caught alone by Mordekaiser R Realm of Death.
Mordekaiser.teamfight: Spread out from your allies so Mordekaiser E Death’s Grasp doesn’t pull several of you in. Activate Yone E Soul Unbound and disrupt the backline, then hit multiple enemies with Yone W Spirit Cleave to build a larger shield. Use Yone R Fate Sealed to pull enemies toward your team, and avoid positions where Mordekaiser R Realm of Death can pull you in alone.
Mordekaiser.watch: If you’re pulled in by Mordekaiser E Death’s Grasp, Mordekaiser Q Obliterate and P Darkness Rise can follow, so don’t engage first with Yone Q Mortal Steel’s tornado while E is available. Mordekaiser P Darkness Rise activates after three hits, so trade briefly and back off. If Mordekaiser R Realm of Death is ready, don’t enter its range alone and risk a duel where your allies can’t help.

Naafiri.build: Yone can take the initiative once his first core item gives him attack speed and critical strike chance. Build armor and health to withstand the physical damage from Naafiri P We Are More, Q Darkin Daggers, and E Eviscerate. If Naafiri’s healing can turn the duel, buy Executioner’s Calling between core items and upgrade it to Mortal Reminder.
Naafiri.combo: For a short trade, stack Yone Q Mortal Steel on minions, then knock her up with tornado Q and deal damage with two basic attacks → Yone W Spirit Cleave → basic attack. For an all-in, first activate Yone E Soul Unbound, then deal damage with tornado Q → basic attack → W → Yone R Fate Sealed → basic attack, and recast E to return. Naafiri W The Call of the Pack makes her untargetable while active, so watch for it to end before trying to finish her off.
Naafiri.escape: Don’t engage just because Naafiri Q Darkin Daggers or E Eviscerate is down; check her other ways to move as well. In particular, while Naafiri R Hounds’ Pursuit is unavailable and she has used Q and E, close the gap with Yone Q Mortal Steel and E Soul Unbound. If Naafiri Q hits you and applies its bleed, delay your engage and dodge the second Q.
Naafiri.fight: Hit minions with Yone Q Mortal Steel to prepare a tornado, then take a short trade when Naafiri Q Darkin Daggers’ bleed is not active. Naafiri E Eviscerate can revive the pack, so the moment after she uses E is your chance to counterattack. Account for Naafiri’s healing in longer fights, and use Yone W Spirit Cleave to gain a shield as her key damage comes in.
Naafiri.laning: Repeated Q use pushes the lane, so when you don’t know where the enemy jungler is, use it less to keep the wave near your side and save Yone E Soul Unbound. If Naafiri has pushed the lane and tornado Q is ready, trade then.
Naafiri.phase: Yone can take the initiative once he completes his first core item, but watch for Naafiri’s roams in the mid game and keep vision broad. In the late game, group with your allies and start head-on teamfights so area damage clears Naafiri’s pack and reduces her damage output.
Naafiri.teamfight: Group with your allies to limit Naafiri’s chances to reach the backline or target an isolated ally. Go deep only while Yone E Soul Unbound is active, and hit multiple enemies with Yone W Spirit Cleave to build a larger shield. Use Yone R Fate Sealed to pull enemies toward your team, and hold it if the angle would leave you deep in their formation.
Naafiri.watch: If you’re hit once by Naafiri Q Darkin Daggers and afflicted with its bleed, create distance until the bleed ends so you don’t get hit by the second Q. Use Yone W Spirit Cleave’s shield to absorb the second Q when it comes in with the pack. Naafiri W The Call of the Pack makes her untargetable while active, so try to finish her off after it ends.

Neeko.build: Prioritize magic resistance against Neeko’s main damage. If being rooted by Neeko E Tangle-Barbs and then hit by Neeko R Pop Blossom kills you, prioritize tenacity. If immobilizing effects from the enemy composition make it difficult to return with Yone E Soul Unbound, buy Quicksilver Sash earlier.
Neeko.combo: Hit minions with Yone Q Mortal Steel to prepare a tornado. Once Neeko E Tangle-Barbs is down, knock her up with tornado Q and trade with two basic attacks → Yone W Spirit Cleave → basic attack. For an all-in, first activate Yone E Soul Unbound, then deal damage with tornado Q → basic attack → W → Yone R Fate Sealed → basic attack before returning with E.
Neeko.escape: If Neeko E Tangle-Barbs is available, don’t dive in with Yone E Soul Unbound.
Neeko.fight: Right after Neeko E Tangle-Barbs is down, close in with Yone Q Mortal Steel’s prepared tornado and trade. While Neeko R Pop Blossom is down, activate Yone E Soul Unbound first and engage so your attacks contribute to the extra damage dealt when you return. If E Tangle-Barbs is available, don’t dash in first with Yone Q Mortal Steel.
Neeko.laning: If Neeko has pushed the lane and Neeko E Tangle-Barbs is down, trade with your prepared tornado. When you don’t know where the enemy jungler is, farm with Q less to keep the wave near your side and save Yone E Soul Unbound.
Neeko.phase: Yone can take the initiative once his first core item gives him attack speed and critical strike chance.
Neeko.teamfight: Spread out so Neeko E Tangle-Barbs doesn’t root several of you. If a transformed enemy approaches, suspect Neeko R Pop Blossom and spread out in advance. Activate Yone E Soul Unbound and disrupt the backline, then hit multiple enemies with Yone W Spirit Cleave to build a larger shield. Use Yone R Fate Sealed from an angle that pulls enemies toward your team, and hold it if the path would leave you deep in their formation.
Neeko.watch: Neeko E Tangle-Barbs grows and speeds up after hitting a target in front, so don’t stand on top of an ally. Watch out for the area of Neeko Q Blooming Burst and the stun and knock-up from Neeko R Pop Blossom, and move away when you see Pop Blossom’s windup. Transformed Neeko has no visible windup, so spread out in advance if someone you suspect is Neeko approaches.

Olaf.build: Prioritize armor against the physical damage from Olaf Q Undertow. However, Olaf Q Undertow reduces armor and Olaf E Reckless Swing deals true damage, so don’t rely on armor to withstand him for long. Yone gets stronger with attack speed and critical strike chance, so use your first core item completion as an opportunity to fight.
Olaf.combo: Hit minions with Yone Q Mortal Steel to prepare a tornado, then knock him up with tornado Q and trade briefly with two basic attacks → Yone W Spirit Cleave → basic attack. For an all-in, first activate Yone E Soul Unbound, then deal damage with tornado Q → basic attack → W → Yone R Fate Sealed → basic attack before recasting E to return. If Olaf R Ragnarok is active, delay an engage that relies on a knock-up and try again after R ends.
Olaf.escape: Olaf has no skill that lets him create distance on his own, so if you’ve prevented him from retrieving Olaf Q Undertow and Olaf R Ragnarok has ended, you have an opening to engage. Activate Yone E Soul Unbound first and close the gap with Yone Q Mortal Steel, deal damage, then return with E.
Olaf.fight: Move to the opposite side of where the axe lands to prevent Olaf from retrieving Olaf Q Undertow, then make a short trade with the Yone Q Mortal Steel stacks you built on minions. Even as Olaf’s health decreases, his attack speed and lifesteal increase, so don’t stay close for long unless you’re sure you can finish him.
Olaf.laning: Early on, use Yone Q Mortal Steel to last-hit, but watch for the lane pushing on its own. When you don’t know where the enemy jungler is, farm with Q less to keep the wave near your side and save Yone E Soul Unbound. If Olaf has pushed the lane, look for a chance to engage with tornado Q, but don’t follow toward the side where Olaf Q Undertow’s axe lands.
Olaf.phase: Yone can take the initiative once his first core item gives him attack speed and critical strike chance. Olaf is relatively weaker late game, so it’s advantageous to stall without losing ground early.
Olaf.teamfight: Activate Yone E Soul Unbound to disrupt the backline and aim to return alive. Hit multiple enemies with Yone W Spirit Cleave to build a larger shield, and use Yone R Fate Sealed to pull enemies toward your team. If Olaf R Ragnarok is active, create distance, then look for a knock-up with Yone Q Mortal Steel or Yone R Fate Sealed after it ends.
Olaf.watch: Olaf Q Undertow reduces armor and slows you, so move to the opposite side of where the axe lands to prevent him from retrieving it. Olaf E Reckless Swing deals true damage, so when your health is low, rely on Yone W Spirit Cleave’s shield and distance rather than armor. While Olaf R Ragnarok is active, don’t rely on the knock-ups from Yone Q Mortal Steel or Yone R Fate Sealed; create distance instead.

Ornn.build: Prioritize completing your first core item with attack speed and critical strike to improve Yone Q Mortal Steel’s attack rhythm and Yone W Spirit Cleave’s shield use. Ornn deals mixed physical and magic damage, so don’t rely on building resistance to only one type. Ornn W Bellows Breath deals damage based on your maximum health, so be wary of stacking health alone.
Ornn.combo: Build stacks of Yone Q Mortal Steel on minions. If Ornn’s crowd control is down, knock him up with dash Yone Q Mortal Steel and trade briefly with two basic attacks → Yone W Spirit Cleave → basic attack. For an all-in, activate Yone E Soul Unbound first, then use dash Yone Q Mortal Steel → basic attack → Yone W Spirit Cleave → Yone R Fate Sealed → basic attack, and return with Yone E Soul Unbound.
Ornn.escape: Look to engage after Ornn E Searing Charge is down and before Ornn R Call of the Forge God is available again. If only one of Ornn’s movement abilities is down, he can escape with the other, so don’t chase recklessly. Don’t use Yone E Soul Unbound to go deep where Ornn’s immobilizing ability is available.
Ornn.fight: Before trading, hit minions with Yone Q Mortal Steel to prepare your dash. Don’t engage first with the dash while crowd control like Ornn E Searing Charge is available; stick to him for a short trade after it is down. Use Yone W Spirit Cleave’s shield when Ornn W Bellows Breath is about to hit.
Ornn.laning: If Ornn tries to craft an item in lane, get on him and interrupt the crafting. If you don’t know where the enemy jungler is, don’t keep pushing the wave with Yone Q Mortal Steel; let the lane come toward you and save Yone E Soul Unbound.
Ornn.phase: Once Yone completes his first core item with attack speed and critical strike, take the initiative and get ahead. Ornn’s items and his allies’ masterwork upgrades add up later, so apply pressure and aim to end the game before then.
Ornn.teamfight: Move out of the line between Ornn and the spirit summoned by Ornn R Call of the Forge God, and avoid its redirected path after Ornn strikes it back once it has passed. Go deep only with Yone E Soul Unbound active, and hit multiple enemies with Yone W Spirit Cleave to build your shield. Use Yone R Fate Sealed to pull enemies toward your team; hold it if the angle would send you through multiple enemies and land deep in their team.
Ornn.watch: The pillar left by Ornn Q Volcanic Rupture is terrain that knocks you airborne if Ornn E Searing Charge hits it. Avoid the pillar and nearby walls, and move toward open ground when you see Ornn E Searing Charge. If the final flame of Ornn W Bellows Breath makes you Brittle, keep your distance until the effect ends to avoid the extra damage and long crowd control.

Pantheon.build: Build attack speed and critical strike toward your first core item. Prioritize armor against Pantheon’s main damage. Pantheon W Shield Vault deals damage based on your maximum health, so avoid stacking health alone.
Pantheon.combo: After Pantheon W Shield Vault is down, hit minions with Yone Q Mortal Steel to prepare your dash. For an all-in, activate Yone E Soul Unbound first, then deal damage with dash Q → basic attack → Yone W Spirit Cleave → Yone R Fate Sealed → basic attack, and recast E. If Pantheon E Aegis Assault is active, don’t attack from the front; wait for it to end or change your angle.
Pantheon.escape: Look to engage when Pantheon W Shield Vault, his stun, is down. If Pantheon R Grand Starfall is also unavailable, you have a bigger window to close the gap with Yone Q Mortal Steel, E Soul Unbound, and R Fate Sealed. If you use E to go deep while W is available, you may be unable to return during the stun.
Pantheon.fight: While Pantheon W Shield Vault is available, don’t engage first with Yone Q Mortal Steel’s dash. Once the stun is down and you have your dash ready, use Yone W Spirit Cleave’s shield against Pantheon’s key attack and trade briefly. Don’t pour damage into Pantheon E Aegis Assault from the front.
Pantheon.laning: Keep a minion between you and Pantheon Q Comet Spear. If you don’t know where the enemy jungler is, don’t keep pushing the wave with Q; save Yone E Soul Unbound.
Pantheon.phase: Yone can take the initiative once he has attack speed and critical strike and completes his first core item. Pantheon’s influence falls off later, so focus on getting through the early game safely.
Pantheon.teamfight: Activate Yone E Soul Unbound to pressure the back line, then hit multiple enemies with Yone W Spirit Cleave to build your shield before returning. Use Yone R Fate Sealed to pull enemies toward your team, and avoid angles that land deep in the enemy team. When you see the landing indicator for Pantheon R Grand Starfall, walk out of its area.
Pantheon.watch: Pantheon W Shield Vault is a targeted stun, so you cannot dodge it while in range. Take Pantheon Q Comet Spear poke with a minion between you, and stop attacking from the front when Pantheon E Aegis Assault is active; wait for it to end.

Poppy.build: Prioritize armor against Poppy’s main damage from Poppy Q Hammer Shock, E Heroic Charge, and R Keeper’s Verdict. Yone gets stronger with attack speed and critical strike, so fight aggressively from the point when you complete your first core item with those stats. You don’t need to build magic resistance just for Poppy.
Poppy.combo: After preparing Yone Q Mortal Steel’s dash on minions, activate Yone E Soul Unbound first when Poppy W Steadfast Presence has ended and Poppy E Heroic Charge is down. Knock her up with Yone Q Mortal Steel’s dash, then deal damage with basic attack → Yone W Spirit Cleave → Yone R Fate Sealed → basic attack, and recast Yone E Soul Unbound to return. Check that Yone R Fate Sealed will pull Poppy toward your team before using it.
Poppy.escape: The chance to close the gap comes right after you force Poppy to use Poppy E Heroic Charge, and you should wait for Poppy W Steadfast Presence to end before dashing in. If you use Yone E Soul Unbound to go deep where Poppy’s immobilizing ability is available, you may not return in time.
Poppy.fight: Hit minions with Yone Q Mortal Steel to prepare your dash, but don’t start a fight with a dash while Poppy W Steadfast Presence is active or Poppy E Heroic Charge is available. Once Poppy E Heroic Charge is down and Poppy W Steadfast Presence ends, engage in open space, and time Yone W Spirit Cleave’s shield for when Poppy Q Hammer Shock is about to hit. Poppy gains more armor and magic resistance at low health, so chase deep only when you can secure the finish.
Poppy.laning: Stand in open space with no wall behind you to avoid the stun from Poppy E Heroic Charge. If Poppy’s buckler lands somewhere safe to step on, step on it first to deny her shield. If you don’t know where the enemy jungler is, don’t push the lane too far with Yone Q Mortal Steel; save Yone E Soul Unbound.
Poppy.phase: Your first core item gives you attack speed and critical strike, making this a power spike; fight when Poppy’s dash and defensive ability are down. The available information is not enough to determine who has the advantage late game, so in team fights prioritize engages you can return from.
Poppy.teamfight: With Yone E Soul Unbound active, pressure the back line and hit multiple champions with Yone W Spirit Cleave to build your shield. Use Yone R Fate Sealed to pull enemies toward your team, and hold it if the angle would land you deep in the enemy team.
Poppy.watch: When Poppy W Steadfast Presence is active, dashing in with Yone Q Mortal Steel or Yone E Soul Unbound gets blocked, and you briefly can’t use movement abilities. Poppy E Heroic Charge stuns you if it pushes you into a wall, so don’t stand with your back to one. If you are hit by the first strike of Poppy Q Hammer Shock, walk out of the area before its second hit detonates. When Poppy charges Poppy R Keeper’s Verdict, move sideways out of her line of attack.

Qiyana.build: Qiyana’s main damage is physical, so prioritize armor. You don’t need to build magic resistance just for the magic damage from Qiyana W Terrashape, and Qiyana R Supreme Display of Talent deals damage based on your maximum health, so be wary of stacking health alone. Fight aggressively once you complete your first core item with attack speed and critical strike.
Qiyana.combo: For an all-in after Qiyana’s movement and immobilizing abilities are down, activate Yone E Soul Unbound first. Then knock her up with Yone Q Mortal Steel’s dash and deal damage with basic attack → Yone W Spirit Cleave → Yone R Fate Sealed → basic attack, then return with Yone E Soul Unbound. For a short trade, engage and knock her up with the dash, then use only two basic attacks → Yone W Spirit Cleave → basic attack before backing off.
Qiyana.escape: If only Qiyana W Terrashape is down, she can escape with Qiyana E Audacity, so don’t rush your engage. In particular, before Qiyana E Audacity is available again, dodge the root from Qiyana Q Elemental Wrath / Edge of Ixtal or the stun from Qiyana R Supreme Display of Talent, then close the gap with Yone Q Mortal Steel, E Soul Unbound, and R Fate Sealed. If you are caught by strong crowd control, you cannot return to your body with Yone E Soul Unbound.
Qiyana.fight: Counterattack after Qiyana uses Qiyana W Terrashape and Qiyana E Audacity and is left in front of you. Before trading, hit minions with Yone Q Mortal Steel to prepare your dash, and use Yone W Spirit Cleave’s shield when Qiyana’s key abilities come at you. If her strong crowd control is still available, don’t use Yone E Soul Unbound to go deep.
Qiyana.laning: Repeatedly using Yone Q Mortal Steel pushes the lane, so if you don’t know where the enemy jungler is, use it less to let the lane come toward you and save Yone E Soul Unbound. If Qiyana has pushed the lane and used her movement ability, trade with your prepared dash.
Qiyana.phase: Avoid giving up advantages and build defensive stats during Qiyana’s strongest mid game. Her relative power falls off later, so move with your team while staying away from terrain to deny Qiyana R Supreme Display of Talent angles.
Qiyana.teamfight: Avoid walls and narrow passages, and don’t give Qiyana R Supreme Display of Talent an angle to hit terrain. Activate Yone E Soul Unbound to get behind the enemy team, and hit multiple enemies with Yone W Spirit Cleave to build your shield. Use Yone R Fate Sealed to pull enemies toward your team, and hold it if the angle would send you deep into their team.
Qiyana.watch: When Qiyana approaches with river element, move out of the root range of Qiyana Q Elemental Wrath / Edge of Ixtal. Fight in an open area, since having your back to a wall lets Qiyana R Supreme Display of Talent knock you into a stun. If she disappears with brush element, move into your team’s vision.

Quinn.build: Quinn P Harrier, Quinn Q Blinding Assault, and Quinn E Vault deal physical damage, so build armor if you need resistance.
Quinn.combo: Hit minions with Yone Q Mortal Steel to prepare your dash. Once Quinn E Vault is down, activate Yone E Soul Unbound first, engage with dash Q, then deal damage with basic attack → Yone W Spirit Cleave → Yone R Fate Sealed → basic attack, and recast E to return.
Quinn.escape: The window to get on Quinn is right after Quinn E Vault is down. Before then, her knockback can interrupt your engage, so don’t use Yone Q Mortal Steel’s dash or Yone E Soul Unbound first.
Quinn.fight: Don’t force an engage alone before Quinn E Vault is down. Right after it is down, close the gap with a dash built by stacking Yone Q Mortal Steel on minions, and time Yone W Spirit Cleave’s shield for Quinn’s counterattack.
Quinn.laning: Farm when Quinn P Harrier’s mark is absent. If you don’t know where the enemy jungler is, manage your Q use so you don’t push the lane, and save Yone E Soul Unbound.
Quinn.phase: Early on, Yone has low attack speed and it’s hard to prepare his dash, so endure Quinn’s poke and farm.
Quinn.teamfight: With Yone E Soul Unbound active, watch where Quinn approaches from the side and look for a chance to knock her up with Yone Q Mortal Steel’s dash or Yone R Fate Sealed. Hit multiple enemies with Yone W Spirit Cleave to build your shield, avoid angles that land deep in the enemy team with R, and return safely with E.
Quinn.watch: When Quinn P Harrier marks you, move out of Quinn’s range to avoid her empowered basic attack. Stand behind minions to make it harder for Quinn Q Blinding Assault to hit you, and don’t engage carelessly with Yone Q Mortal Steel’s dash while Quinn E Vault is available.

Renekton.build: Prioritize armor against the physical damage from Renekton Q Cull the Meek, W Ruthless Predator, and E Slice and Dice. Empowered Renekton E Slice and Dice reduces your armor, so focus on positioning to dodge the dash rather than simply stacking more armor. If the healing from Renekton Q Cull the Meek could turn the duel, buy Executioner’s Calling between core items and upgrade it to Mortal Reminder.
Renekton.combo: When Renekton has no Fury and Renekton W Ruthless Predator and E Slice and Dice are down, hit minions with Yone Q Mortal Steel to prepare your dash. For a short trade, knock him up with dash Q Mortal Steel, then hit two basic attacks → Yone W Spirit Cleave → basic attack and back off. For an extended fight, activate Yone E Soul Unbound first, then use dash Q Mortal Steel, basic attack, W Spirit Cleave, R Fate Sealed, and basic attack before returning with E.
Renekton.escape: Look to engage during a window when Renekton E Slice and Dice is down and he cannot use the stun from W Ruthless Predator. If Renekton’s crowd control is still available, don’t dive in with Yone E Soul Unbound. When backing off after taking Renekton’s combo, choose a direction with no target for him to use E on.
Renekton.fight: Trade when Renekton has no Fury, and keep your distance when he has built up Fury. Counterattack right after Renekton uses Q Cull the Meek, W Ruthless Predator, and E Slice and Dice; especially if he uses E to disengage, close the gap with Yone Q Mortal Steel or E Soul Unbound. Don’t engage first with Yone Q Mortal Steel’s dash while Renekton W Ruthless Predator is available.
Renekton.laning: Adjust your position, since standing in or behind your minion wave gives Renekton E Slice and Dice a target for its first dash. If you don’t know where the enemy jungler is, don’t keep pushing the lane by farming with Q; save Yone E Soul Unbound.
Renekton.phase: As Renekton’s value falls from the mid game onward, Yone can take the initiative more once his first core item is complete, so focus on not giving up early kills.
Renekton.teamfight: With Yone E Soul Unbound active, pressure the back line and secure a place to return to. Hit multiple enemies with Yone W Spirit Cleave to build your shield, but don’t rely on it against Renekton W Ruthless Predator when he has built up Fury. Use Yone R Fate Sealed to pull enemies toward your team, and avoid angles that pass through multiple champions and land deep in the enemy team.
Renekton.watch: Be wary of empowered Renekton W Ruthless Predator when Renekton’s Fury is above half or slightly below half. Empowered W breaks Yone W Spirit Cleave’s shield first, so don’t try to tank a combo with your shield while you are within Renekton’s range and he has built up Fury.

Rumble.build: Prioritize attack speed and critical strike toward your first core item. If you need a defensive item, choose one with magic resistance to account for Rumble’s magic damage, and avoid stacking health alone because he has damage based on your maximum health.
Rumble.combo: Hit minions with Yone Q Mortal Steel to prepare your dash, then wait out Rumble W Scrap Shield’s shield. For a short trade, knock him up with dash Q, then use two basic attacks → Yone W Spirit Cleave → basic attack before backing off. For an all-in, activate Yone E Soul Unbound first, then deal damage with dash Q, basic attack, W, Yone R Fate Sealed, and basic attack before recasting E to return.
Rumble.escape: After Rumble has also used W Scrap Shield, look to engage while its shield and movement speed bonus are down. If you are hit by the first Rumble E Electro Harpoon, escape with Yone E Soul Unbound or prepared Yone Q Mortal Steel before the second shot comes. When engaging, activate Yone E Soul Unbound first to secure a way back to your starting position after the fight.
Rumble.fight: Hit minions with Yone Q Mortal Steel to prepare your dash, and trade briefly to avoid staying in Rumble Q Flamespitter. If Rumble activates W Scrap Shield, hold your burst damage until the shield disappears, then close in. Rumble has no movement ability, so when an engage angle opens, close the gap with Yone Q Mortal Steel and Yone E Soul Unbound.
Rumble.laning: Repeatedly using Q pushes the wave, so if you don’t know where the enemy jungler is, use it less to let the lane come toward you and save Yone E Soul Unbound. If Rumble has pushed the lane and you have an angle to engage with dash Q, look to trade.
Rumble.phase: Once your first core item gives you attack speed and critical strike, take the initiative and start fights. In late game team fights, engage with Yone E Soul Unbound active, deal damage, and focus on getting back alive.
Rumble.teamfight: Activate Yone E Soul Unbound to pressure the enemy back line, then return to your starting position. Use Yone W Spirit Cleave to graze multiple enemies and build your shield. Use Yone R Fate Sealed to pull enemies toward your team, and hold it if the angle would pass through multiple enemies and land you deep in their team.
Rumble.watch: Rumble Q Flamespitter deals damage based on your maximum health while you stay close, so don’t fight while taking its damage for long. If you are hit by the first Rumble E Electro Harpoon, create distance with Yone E Soul Unbound or prepared Yone Q Mortal Steel before the second harpoon increases the slow and magic resistance reduction. Also watch for the slow from Rumble R The Equalizer and the silence from Rumble P Junkyard Titan when engaging.

Ryze.build: Ryze’s main damage is magic damage, so prioritize magic resistance if you need resistances. Yone gets stronger starting with his first core item, which provides attack speed and critical strike chance, so make use of that timing. If you’re often caught by immobilizing effects from the enemy team, get Quicksilver Sash earlier.
Ryze.combo: For an all-in, prepare Yone Q Mortal Steel’s tornado and activate Yone E Soul Unbound first. Knock him up with tornado Q, then deal damage with a basic attack → Yone W Spirit Cleave → Yone R Fate Sealed → a basic attack, then recast Yone E Soul Unbound to return. Wait to engage if Ryze E Spell Flux and Ryze W Rune Prison are available.
Ryze.escape: The moment after Ryze E Spell Flux and Ryze W Rune Prison are down is your window to engage with Yone E Soul Unbound. If Ryze casts Ryze R Realm Warp, you can interrupt it before it activates with the knock-up from Yone Q Mortal Steel or Yone R Fate Sealed.
Ryze.fight: Hit minions with Yone Q Mortal Steel to prepare the tornado, then engage while Ryze E Spell Flux and Ryze W Rune Prison are down. After knocking him up, use two basic attacks and Yone W Spirit Cleave, then back off.
Ryze.laning: If Ryze pushes the lane, engage with your prepared tornado and apply pressure to slow his growth before he gets his items. When you don’t know where the enemy jungler is, control your use of Yone Q Mortal Steel so you don’t push the lane, and save Yone E Soul Unbound.
Ryze.phase: Ryze also lacks mana and damage early, so pressure him once you can prepare Yone Q Mortal Steel’s tornado. Yone can take the initiative in fights starting with his first completed core item that provides attack speed and critical strike chance. In later teamfights, look for an engage you can return from safely.
Ryze.teamfight: Use Yone E Soul Unbound to engage Ryze and deny him time to cycle through his combo. Hit multiple champions with Yone W Spirit Cleave to build its shield, and aim Yone R Fate Sealed to pull enemies toward your team. Hold your ultimate if it would pass through multiple enemies and leave you deep in their team; preserve a path to return.
Ryze.watch: If you’re hit by Ryze E Spell Flux, the following Ryze W Rune Prison becomes a root, and Ryze Q Overload deals increased damage. If you’re marked, move away from allies, and time Yone W Spirit Cleave’s shield to absorb Ryze Q Overload as it hits.

Shen.build: Prioritize attack speed and critical strike chance to capitalize on the timing of Yone’s first completed core item. Attack speed also reduces Yone W Spirit Cleave’s cast time and cooldown. For defense, consider tenacity first to counter the taunt from Shen E Shadow Dash, and account for both the physical damage from Shen E Shadow Dash and the magic damage from Shen Q Twilight Assault when choosing resistances.
Shen.combo: Hit minions with Yone Q Mortal Steel to prepare the tornado. If Shen E Shadow Dash misses and Shen W Spirit's Refuge is also down, attack in this order: Yone E Soul Unbound → tornado Q → a basic attack → Yone W Spirit Cleave → Yone R Fate Sealed → a basic attack. After dealing damage, recast Yone E Soul Unbound to return to your original position.
Shen.escape: The moment after Shen E Shadow Dash misses is your opportunity to engage with Yone Q Mortal Steel and Yone E Soul Unbound. If Shen R Stand United is also down, Shen has fewer options to escape with a mobility ability. While Shen E Shadow Dash is available, its taunt may prevent Yone E Soul Unbound from returning you in time, so delay your engage.
Shen.fight: Hit minions with Yone Q Mortal Steel to prepare the tornado, but don’t engage first with tornado Q while Shen E Shadow Dash is available. If Shen E Shadow Dash misses, activate Yone E Soul Unbound first, then engage with tornado Q and deal damage. Stop basic attacking when Shen W Spirit's Refuge comes out, and resume attacking after it ends.
Shen.laning: When you don’t know where the enemy jungler is, don’t keep pushing the lane with Q, and save Yone E Soul Unbound. Once you have the initiative, keep Shen occupied farming to raise the cost of using Shen R Stand United to affect another lane.
Shen.phase: Even though Shen’s early laning is relatively weak, focus on lane control rather than kills during this phase. Yone can fight aggressively once his first core item provides attack speed and critical strike chance. Later, look for an engage with Yone E Soul Unbound that lets you return safely instead of assuming who wins a one-on-one fight.
Shen.teamfight: Use Yone E Soul Unbound to engage the backline, and hit multiple champions with Yone W Spirit Cleave to build its shield. Aim Yone R Fate Sealed to pull enemies toward your team, and hold it if the angle would leave you deep in the enemy team.
Shen.watch: If you’re taunted by Shen E Shadow Dash, you’ll take empowered basic attacks from Shen Q Twilight Assault, so avoid the dash path. When Shen Q Twilight Assault’s blade returns, move out of the path where it will collide with you. Save Yone’s basic attacks, including Yone Q Mortal Steel, which counts as a basic attack, while Shen W Spirit's Refuge is active.

Singed.build: Singed Q Poison Trail and Singed E Fling deal magic damage, so build magic resistance instead of relying on armor or health alone. Prepare for Yone’s stronger trading once his first core item provides attack speed and critical strike chance. If you’re often caught by the combination of Singed W Mega Adhesive and Singed E Fling, get Quicksilver Sash earlier.
Singed.combo: Hit minions with Yone Q Mortal Steel to prepare the tornado, then dodge Singed E Fling and engage where Singed W Mega Adhesive isn’t active. For a short trade, knock him up with tornado Yone Q Mortal Steel, then use two basic attacks, Yone W Spirit Cleave, and a basic attack before backing off. For an all-in, activate Yone E Soul Unbound first, then use tornado Yone Q Mortal Steel, a basic attack, Yone W Spirit Cleave, Yone R Fate Sealed, and a basic attack, then use Yone E Soul Unbound to return.
Singed.escape: Singed has no ability to create distance on his own, so dodge Singed E Fling and engage during a window when Singed W Mega Adhesive isn’t active. Yone E Soul Unbound can’t return you to your body if you’re hit by strong crowd control, so delay your engage where Singed W Mega Adhesive and Singed E Fling can be chained together.
Singed.fight: Before trading, hit minions with Yone Q Mortal Steel to prepare the tornado. Don’t go deep with Yone E Soul Unbound while Singed W Mega Adhesive is active on the ground or when Singed E Fling could catch you. After dodging Singed E Fling, knock him up with Yone Q Mortal Steel for a short trade, and don’t chase along Singed Q Poison Trail.
Singed.laning: Repeatedly using Yone Q Mortal Steel pushes the lane, so when you don’t know where the enemy jungler is, use it less and save Yone E Soul Unbound. If Singed has pushed the lane, take a short trade with your prepared tornado.
Singed.phase: Yone can take the initiative in fights starting with his first completed core item that provides attack speed and critical strike chance. Singed becomes difficult to catch once he has his core items, so don’t chase him for long through his poison after that.
Singed.teamfight: If Singed engages, hold him with Yone Q Mortal Steel or Yone R Fate Sealed and attack his allies during that time. Engage with Yone E Soul Unbound active and hit multiple champions with Yone W Spirit Cleave to build its shield. Aim Yone R Fate Sealed to pull enemies toward your team, and hold it if the angle would leave you deep in the enemy team.
Singed.watch: Following Singed Q Poison Trail means continuously taking poison damage, so don’t chase even if he looks low unless you have enough damage to finish him reliably. You can’t use movement abilities on Singed W Mega Adhesive, and if Singed E Fling hits you there, it also roots you, so go around the adhesive. If Singed has his back to your team, don’t stand in front of him, as Singed E Fling can throw you into the enemy team.

Sion.build: Prioritize completing your first core item with attack speed and critical strike chance to increase Yone’s fighting power. If you need resistances, prioritize armor against the physical damage from Sion P Glory in Death, Q Decimating Smash, and R Unstoppable Onslaught. Armor doesn’t block the magic damage from Sion W Soul Furnace and E Roar of the Slayer, and getting hit by E also reduces your armor, so dodging it is important.
Sion.combo: After Sion Q Decimating Smash is down, knock him up with your prepared Yone Q Mortal Steel tornado, then use two basic attacks, Yone W Spirit Cleave, and a basic attack for a short trade. For an all-in, activate Yone E Soul Unbound first, then deal damage with tornado Q, a basic attack, W, Yone R Fate Sealed, and a basic attack, then recast E to return.
Sion.escape: After Sion Q Decimating Smash’s crowd control is down, close the gap with Yone Q Mortal Steel and E Soul Unbound. While Q is available, don’t dive in first with tornado Q or E.
Sion.fight: Hit minions with Yone Q Mortal Steel to prepare the tornado, then take a short trade after Sion Q Decimating Smash is down. When Sion W Soul Furnace activates, focus your damage on it immediately to break the shield, and use Yone W Spirit Cleave to gain a shield and deal damage based on his maximum health.
Sion.laning: If you keep using Q to push the lane and Yone E Soul Unbound is also down, you’re vulnerable to ganks, so pull the lane toward you and save E when you don’t know where the enemy jungler is. Sion’s maximum health increases as he keeps farming, so when it’s safe, disrupt his farming or gain an advantage in another lane.
Sion.phase: Yone can take the initiative in fights after his first core item provides attack speed and critical strike chance. Sion stacks maximum health through farming as the game goes on, so don’t let him keep farming and drag the game out.
Sion.teamfight: Use Yone E Soul Unbound to pressure the backline while keeping a place to return to safely. Hit multiple champions with Yone W Spirit Cleave to build its shield, and aim Yone R Fate Sealed to pull enemies toward your team. Hold R if the angle would pass through several enemies and leave you deep in their team.
Sion.watch: If Sion charges Sion Q Decimating Smash for a long time, it knocks you up and stuns you, so sidestep it. Sion R Unstoppable Onslaught charges in a straight line, so avoid narrow paths and move aside.
