After Sion falls, Sion P Glory in Death revives him and lets him attack quickly, so don’t keep fighting in place.

Skarner.build: If Skarner R Impale is a threat, decide early whether to include Quicksilver Sash or Mercurial Scimitar in your build. Prioritize magic resistance against the damage from Skarner P Threads of Vibration, Skarner W Seismic Bastion, and Skarner R Impale. Use Yone’s first core item as the point to secure attack speed and critical strike chance.
Skarner.combo: Hit minions with Yone Q Mortal Steel to build stacks, then activate Yone E Soul Unbound first. If Skarner E Ixtal's Impact is down, engage with tornado Yone Q Mortal Steel, then deal damage with a basic attack, Yone W Spirit Cleave, Yone R Fate Sealed, and a basic attack, then recast Yone E Soul Unbound to return. If Skarner’s crowd control is available, don’t engage first with tornado Yone Q Mortal Steel.
Skarner.escape: Immediately after you force Skarner to use Skarner E Ixtal's Impact is your window to engage. However, if Skarner R Impale is available, delay your engage because suppression may stop Yone E Soul Unbound from returning you. After engaging, deal damage and use Yone E Soul Unbound to return to your original position.
Skarner.fight: Immediately after Skarner E Ixtal's Impact is down, close the gap with Yone Q Mortal Steel and Yone E Soul Unbound. Before trading, hit minions with Yone Q Mortal Steel to prepare the tornado, then fight in a rhythm of two basic attacks at a time after engaging. Time Yone W Spirit Cleave’s shield to absorb Skarner’s key damage, and don’t stay close for long.
Skarner.laning: Repeatedly using Yone Q Mortal Steel pushes the wave, so when you don’t know where Skarner is, pull the lane toward you and save Yone E Soul Unbound. If Skarner E Ixtal's Impact successfully collides with a wall, back off and keep his next dash in mind.
Skarner.phase: Late game, Skarner can gain both damage and durability from tank items, so play to avoid being held in place for long.
Skarner.teamfight: Only go deep with Yone E Soul Unbound active, and hit multiple champions with Yone W Spirit Cleave to build its shield. Aim Yone R Fate Sealed to pull enemies toward your team, and avoid angles where it passes through several enemies and leaves you deep in their team. Keep Skarner R Impale’s range and the direction he could pull you in mind, and don’t stand close to the edges of the Dragon or Baron pit.
Skarner.watch: Skarner E Ixtal's Impact dashes through terrain, and if he catches you and you hit a wall, you’ll be stunned, so don’t stand with your back to a wall. Skarner R Impale’s suppression can’t be cleansed by Yone E Soul Unbound, so don’t go deep while Skarner R Impale is available. Move outside melee range so you don’t keep taking empowered basic attacks from Skarner Q Shattered Earth/Upheaval.

Sylas.watch: Sylas E Abscond / Abduct: the chains he throws afterward are more dangerous than the initial dash.

Syndra.build: Buying boots early to gain movement speed makes it easier to walk out of Syndra’s ground-targeted abilities. Prioritize magic resistance against Syndra’s main ability damage, and also get enough health to withstand the true damage from Syndra W Force of Will and the execute from Syndra R Unleashed Power.
Syndra.combo: When Syndra E Scatter the Weak is down, knock her up with your prepared tornado Yone Q Mortal Steel, then trade with two basic attacks, Yone W Spirit Cleave, and a basic attack. For an all-in, activate Yone E Soul Unbound first, then deal damage with tornado Yone Q Mortal Steel, a basic attack, Yone W Spirit Cleave, Yone R Fate Sealed, and a basic attack, then recast E to return.
Syndra.escape: Syndra has no mobility ability, but she can stop Yone’s engage with Syndra E Scatter the Weak, so use the moment after that ability is down as your window to engage. Don’t dive in with Yone E Soul Unbound while Syndra E Scatter the Weak is available or while you’re standing in line with an orb.
Syndra.fight: Engage and fight right after Syndra E Scatter the Weak is down. Before trading, hit minions with Yone Q Mortal Steel to prepare the tornado, and time Yone W Spirit Cleave’s shield to absorb Syndra’s key abilities as they hit. After engaging, account for the time needed to land two basic attacks, then back off.
Syndra.laning: Repeatedly using Q pushes the lane, so when you don’t know where the enemy jungler is, farm with Q less to pull the lane toward you and save Yone E Soul Unbound. If Syndra pushes the lane and opens an angle to engage with the tornado, check that Syndra E Scatter the Weak is down before trading.
Syndra.phase: Late game, rather than assuming which of you is stronger, consider where Syndra’s orbs are placed and where Yone can return before engaging.
Syndra.teamfight: Use Yone E Soul Unbound to pressure the backline while dodging Syndra E Scatter the Weak and stun angles created by her orbs. Hit multiple champions with Yone W Spirit Cleave to build its shield, and aim Yone R Fate Sealed to pull enemies toward your team. Avoid areas with many Syndra Q Dark Sphere orbs and angles where Yone R Fate Sealed would take you too deep.
Syndra.watch: If you see an orb in the line between you and Syndra, move out of that line, and don’t engage first with Yone Q Mortal Steel’s tornado while Syndra E Scatter the Weak is available. Also watch out for the execute from Syndra R Unleashed Power in areas with many orbs.

TahmKench.build: Build magic resistance first against Tahm Kench’s main damage. If the healing from Tahm Kench Q Tongue Lash and Tahm Kench E Thick Skin can swing the duel, buy Executioner’s Calling between core items, then upgrade it to Mortal Reminder.
TahmKench.combo: Hit minions with Yone Q Mortal Steel to prepare your tornado. To engage, cast Yone E Soul Unbound first, then knock him up with tornado Q and deal damage in this order: basic attack, Yone W Spirit Cleave, Yone R Fate Sealed, basic attack. Start this sequence while Tahm Kench’s immobilizing ability is down, then return with Yone E Soul Unbound after dealing damage.
TahmKench.escape: When Tahm Kench W Abyssal Dive is down, look for a chance to engage, since it becomes harder for him to engage or escape. Don’t enter with Yone E Soul Unbound while Tahm Kench Q Tongue Lash can stun you or Tahm Kench P An Acquired Taste has stacks; engage after the stacks expire.
TahmKench.fight: Tahm Kench E Thick Skin can turn damage into a shield or healing, so fight when you can deal damage in a burst rather than taking short trades one hit at a time. Engage with Yone E Soul Unbound when Tahm Kench has no stacks and Tahm Kench Q Tongue Lash’s stun and Tahm Kench W Abyssal Dive are down. Even when Tahm Kench is healthy, use the max-health damage from Yone W Spirit Cleave in trades.
TahmKench.laning: When you don’t know where the enemy jungler is, don’t keep pushing the wave with Yone Q Mortal Steel; save Yone E Soul Unbound. Even if Tahm Kench pushes the lane and gives you an angle to engage with your tornado, back off first if Tahm Kench P An Acquired Taste has stacks.
TahmKench.phase: Once your first core item is complete and you have attack speed and critical strike, Yone can take the initiative in fights. The information given isn’t enough to determine who has the advantage late game, so choose an engage angle that lets you get back out alive in teamfights.
TahmKench.teamfight: Target the backline Tahm Kench is protecting rather than focusing him first, but account for Tahm Kench R Devour being available: his target can be swallowed, shielded, and saved. Go deep only while Yone E Soul Unbound is active, and hit multiple enemies with Yone W Spirit Cleave to build a larger shield. Use Yone R Fate Sealed to pull enemies toward your team, and save it if the angle would leave you deep in enemy territory.
TahmKench.watch: If you judge that Tahm Kench P An Acquired Taste has stacked twice, back off and wait for the stacks to expire. While Tahm Kench Q Tongue Lash can stun you, don’t dive in first with Yone Q Mortal Steel’s tornado or Yone E Soul Unbound. When you see Tahm Kench W Abyssal Dive’s dive animation, move away from the landing point to avoid the area knock-up.

Talon.build: All of Talon’s damage is physical, so build armor first in the early game, such as Cloth Armor. Also build health, since Talon’s lethality can reduce the value of low armor. If the healing from Talon Q Noxian Diplomacy can swing the duel, fit Executioner’s Calling between core items and upgrade it to Mortal Reminder.
Talon.combo: Hit minions with Yone Q Mortal Steel to prepare your tornado. In a short trade, knock him up with tornado Q, then attack in this order: two basic attacks, Yone W Spirit Cleave, basic attack. For an all-in, cast Yone E Soul Unbound first, then use tornado Q, basic attack, W, Yone R Fate Sealed, and basic attack before returning with E. If you cast E too late, the damage dealt before it won’t count toward the return damage.
Talon.escape: Right after Talon uses Talon Q Noxian Diplomacy is your chance to close the gap, so engage with a prepared Yone Q Mortal Steel or Yone E Soul Unbound. If you’ve confirmed Talon E Assassin’s Path and Talon R Shadow Assault are also down, you’ll have a clearer chance to chase or engage with Yone R Fate Sealed. When going in with Yone E Soul Unbound, keep in mind where and when you’ll return.
Talon.fight: Hit minions with Yone Q Mortal Steel to prepare your tornado, then close the gap right after Talon uses Talon Q Noxian Diplomacy. Avoid the return path of Talon W Rake and use Yone W Spirit Cleave to absorb key damage. Take the initiative from the point when your first core item gives you attack speed and critical strike.
Talon.laning: Push the wave first to avoid giving Talon the level advantage, but when you don’t know where the enemy jungler is, farm less with Q, pull the lane toward you, and save Yone E Soul Unbound. If Talon roams, share his location and ward jungle routes.
Talon.phase: Once Yone completes his first core item, attack speed and critical strike let him take the initiative in fights. Talon’s influence wanes late game, so group with your team and fight together.
Talon.teamfight: If Talon dives your backline, group with your team and use Yone Q Mortal Steel and Yone R Fate Sealed to control his entry. When Yone goes into the enemy backline, cast Yone E Soul Unbound first, then hit multiple enemies with Yone W Spirit Cleave to build a larger shield. Use R to pull enemies toward your team, and save it if the angle would leave you deep in enemy territory.
Talon.watch: If Talon W Rake hits you on both the outward and return paths, Talon P Blade’s End can make the follow-up dangerous. If the first hit lands, move off the return path, and time Yone W Spirit Cleave’s shield to absorb the damage from Talon Q Noxian Diplomacy. Don’t chase recklessly while Talon R Shadow Assault is available, since he can escape with stealth.

Teemo.build: Build magic resistance first against the magic damage from Teemo Q Blinding Dart, E Toxic Shot, and R Noxious Trap.
Teemo.combo: Before trading, hit minions with Yone Q Mortal Steel to prepare your tornado. Once Teemo Q Blinding Dart is down, deal damage in this order: Yone E Soul Unbound → tornado Q Mortal Steel → basic attack → W Spirit Cleave → R Fate Sealed → basic attack, then recast E Soul Unbound to return.
Teemo.escape: Right after Teemo uses Teemo Q Blinding Dart is your chance to engage and follow up with basic attacks. If Teemo W Move Quick is also down, close the gap with Yone Q Mortal Steel and E Soul Unbound.
Teemo.fight: Right after Teemo Q Blinding Dart is down, use stacks of Yone Q Mortal Steel built on minions to prepare your tornado and engage. Because of Teemo E Toxic Shot, avoid trades where you take one hit and then back off; if you engage, keep landing basic attacks.
Teemo.laning: When you don’t know where the jungler is, don’t keep pushing the lane with Q; save Yone E Soul Unbound. Avoid standing beside bushes without vision, and respond after Teemo P Guerrilla Warfare’s invisibility ends.
Teemo.phase: Take the initiative once your first core item is complete and you have attack speed and critical strike. As the game goes on, Teemo R Noxious Trap can remain on paths, so check your route.
Teemo.teamfight: Cast Yone E Soul Unbound before engaging, then hit multiple enemies with W Spirit Cleave to build a larger shield. Use Yone R Fate Sealed to pull enemies toward your team, and save it if the angle would leave you deep in enemy territory. Use Oracle Lens to clear Teemo R Noxious Trap in front of objectives and in narrow passages.
Teemo.watch: While affected by Teemo Q Blinding Dart, your basic attacks are negated, so stop basic attacking and use Yone W Spirit Cleave to block damage or back off. Watch for Teemo P Guerrilla Warfare’s stealth in bushes without vision, and be wary of Teemo R Noxious Trap at key paths.

Trundle.build: Build armor first against Trundle Q Chomp and his basic attacks. Trundle R Subjugate deals magic damage and steals resistances, so getting out of its range takes priority over stacking more resistances. If Trundle’s healing can swing the duel, buy Executioner’s Calling between core items and upgrade it to Mortal Reminder.
Trundle.combo: Hit minions with Yone Q Mortal Steel to prepare your tornado. If Trundle E Pillar of Ice is down, cast Yone E Soul Unbound first, then engage with tornado Q Mortal Steel and deal damage in this order: basic attack, Yone W Spirit Cleave, Yone R Fate Sealed, basic attack. Return with E Soul Unbound. Time the shield from W Spirit Cleave to block Trundle Q Chomp as it comes in.
Trundle.escape: Engage in open terrain after Trundle E Pillar of Ice is down. Trundle has no ability to create distance on his own, so you can close the gap with a tornado from Yone Q Mortal Steel and Yone E Soul Unbound. If Trundle W Frozen Domain is active or Trundle R Subjugate is active, back off first and wait out that strong window.
Trundle.fight: Back out of Trundle W Frozen Domain and let its duration run out before fighting again. If Trundle E Pillar of Ice is down and you have an angle to engage in open terrain, close in with a tornado from Yone Q Mortal Steel that you prepared earlier and deal damage in a short trade. Create distance while Trundle R Subjugate is active, then look for another opportunity.
Trundle.laning: Trundle P King's Tribute heals him whenever a nearby unit dies, so after chipping away at health, secure an immediate gain or push the lane to force a recall. When you don't know where the enemy jungler is, don't push too far by farming with Q; save Yone E Soul Unbound.
Trundle.phase: Once Yone has attack speed and critical strike and completes his first core item, he gains the power to take the initiative in fights.
Trundle.teamfight: Use Yone E Soul Unbound to pressure the backline and get back out alive. Hit multiple enemies with Yone W Spirit Cleave to build a larger shield, and use Yone R Fate Sealed to pull enemies toward your team. While Trundle R Subjugate is active, target someone else or create distance instead of hitting Trundle.
Trundle.watch: Trundle E Pillar of Ice blocks escape routes in narrow paths, so fight in open terrain and immediately move to the side when the pillar appears. When Trundle R Subjugate is active, he steals your resistances and becomes tankier, so create distance.

TwistedFate.build: Build attack speed and critical strike first to improve your trades with Yone Q Mortal Steel and the shield from Yone W Spirit Cleave. If you build resistances against Twisted Fate’s damage, choose magic resistance over armor.
TwistedFate.combo: For an all-in, cast Yone E Soul Unbound first, then engage with a prepared Yone Q Mortal Steel tornado. If Twisted Fate W Pick a Card’s gold card is still available, it could stop your engage or return with a stun, so wait until the card is down before starting.
TwistedFate.escape: Right after Twisted Fate W Pick a Card’s gold card is used is your chance to engage with Yone Q Mortal Steel or Yone E Soul Unbound.
TwistedFate.fight: Hit minions with Yone Q Mortal Steel to prepare your tornado, then engage the moment Twisted Fate W Pick a Card’s gold card is down. It’s safer to engage if he’s holding a blue or red card. For a short trade, knock him up with your tornado, follow with two basic attacks and Yone W Spirit Cleave, then back off.
TwistedFate.laning: Look for an angle to engage with your tornado when Twisted Fate has pushed the lane, but if you don’t know where the enemy jungler is, pull the lane toward you and save Yone E Soul Unbound.
TwistedFate.phase: Yone can take the initiative in fights after getting attack speed and critical strike and completing his first core item. Late game, choose an engage when Twisted Fate W Pick a Card’s gold card is down instead of assuming you have a decisive advantage.
TwistedFate.teamfight: Once Twisted Fate W Pick a Card’s gold card is used, cast Yone E Soul Unbound and go into the backline to target Twisted Fate. If you see Twisted Fate R Destiny’s teleport and he is within range, interrupt it with the knock-up from Yone Q Mortal Steel’s tornado or the crowd control from Yone R Fate Sealed.
TwistedFate.watch: If Twisted Fate has locked in a gold card with Twisted Fate W Pick a Card, one basic attack will stun you, so wait outside his basic attack range. Twisted Fate Q Wild Cards is an area poke ability, so stand behind minions to reduce the damage you take and time Yone W Spirit Cleave’s shield to absorb the cards as they fly toward you.

Udyr.build: Aim for your first core item with attack speed and critical strike, but build armor first for resistance against Udyr’s attacks. Udyr R Wingborne Storm deals magic damage, and Udyr Q Wilding Claw deals both damage types, so armor alone can’t block everything. If the healing from Udyr W Iron Mantle can swing the duel, buy Executioner’s Calling between core items and upgrade it to Mortal Reminder.
Udyr.combo: After Udyr E Blazing Stampede’s stun is down and its Awakened state has ended, hit minions with Yone Q Mortal Steel to prepare your tornado. For an all-in, deal damage in this order: Yone E Soul Unbound → tornado Yone Q Mortal Steel → basic attack → Yone W Spirit Cleave → Yone R Fate Sealed → basic attack, then recast Yone E Soul Unbound to return. Don’t use Yone R Fate Sealed if its path would take you too far behind Udyr.
Udyr.escape: Right after you bait Udyr into using Udyr E Blazing Stampede is your window to close the gap with Yone Q Mortal Steel, Yone E Soul Unbound, or Yone R Fate Sealed. Delay your engage if Udyr’s stun is still available or E is Awakened. When escaping, don’t rely on running alone; use Yone E Soul Unbound’s return or Yone Q Mortal Steel and Yone R Fate Sealed.
Udyr.fight: A window to fight opens after you've absorbed one stun from Udyr E Blazing Stampede or right after Udyr uses that ability. Before trading, hit minions with Yone Q Mortal Steel to prepare your tornado. Once Udyr W Iron Mantle's shield is gone, press the attack without giving him time to heal. Gain a shield from Yone W Spirit Cleave when Udyr's key attack comes in.
Udyr.laning: Udyr appears from the jungle to gank, so ward key paths and jungle entrances, and don’t move forward if you can’t see where he is. At those times, don’t push the wave too far with Yone Q Mortal Steel; save Yone E Soul Unbound.
Udyr.phase: From the point when Yone completes his first core item with attack speed and critical strike, he can take the initiative in fights. Late game, rather than insisting on a head-on duel based on an assumption about your relative strength against Udyr, find an engage path in teamfights that lets you get back out alive.
Udyr.teamfight: Don't try to force a quick kill on Udyr first when he has defensive items and Udyr W Iron Mantle; target weaker enemies behind him. Cast Yone E Soul Unbound to go in and hit multiple enemies with Yone W Spirit Cleave to build a larger shield. Use Yone R Fate Sealed to pull enemies toward your team, and save it if its path would leave you deep in enemy territory.
Udyr.watch: Udyr E Blazing Stampede increases his movement speed so he can approach and stun with his first attack. Don’t go deep with Yone E Soul Unbound right after Udyr activates E anew. Immobilizing effects don’t work while Udyr E is Awakened, so stop him with Yone Q Mortal Steel or Yone R Fate Sealed after it ends.

Veigar.build: Yone gets stronger with attack speed and critical strike chance, so prioritize completing your first core item. Veigar Q Baleful Strike, W Dark Matter, and R Primordial Burst all deal magic damage, so build magic resistance if you need defenses.
Veigar.combo: Hit minions with Yone Q Mortal Steel to prepare your tornado. When all-inning after Veigar E Event Horizon is down, deal damage in this order: Yone E Soul Unbound → tornado Q → basic attack → Yone W Spirit Cleave → Yone R Fate Sealed → basic attack, then recast E to return. For a short trade, knock him up with tornado Q, land two basic attacks, W, and another basic attack, then back off.
Veigar.escape: Veigar has no mobility ability to create distance, so the moment Veigar E Event Horizon is down is your chance to engage. If you’re trapped inside E Event Horizon, don’t force your way through the edge; move around inside, then use Yone Q Mortal Steel, E Soul Unbound, and R Fate Sealed as you get out.
Veigar.fight: Afterward, hit minions with Q to prepare your tornado, but don’t dive in first with tornado Q or Yone E Soul Unbound while Veigar E Event Horizon is available. When Veigar E Event Horizon is down, move to close the distance and fight, and time Yone W Spirit Cleave’s shield to absorb the falling Veigar W Dark Matter.
Veigar.laning: Position behind minions so Veigar Q Baleful Strike doesn’t hit you unnecessarily and give him growth stacks. Repeatedly using Yone Q Mortal Steel pushes the lane, so use it less to farm and save Yone E Soul Unbound when you don’t know where the enemy jungler is. If Veigar has pushed the lane and used E Event Horizon, look for an angle to engage with tornado Q.
Veigar.phase: Yone can take the initiative after gaining attack speed and critical strike chance and completing his first core item. Veigar’s growth stacks are permanent, so you fall behind as the game goes on. Before objective fights, check Veigar’s position and whether he has used E Event Horizon.
Veigar.teamfight: Use Yone E Soul Unbound to enter the enemy backline, and hit multiple enemies with Yone W Spirit Cleave to build a larger shield. Aim Yone R Fate Sealed to pull enemies toward your team; save it if the angle would carry you through several enemies and leave you deep in their formation. Check whether Veigar has used E Event Horizon before going in so you don’t get trapped and hit repeatedly.
Veigar.watch: Veigar E Event Horizon stuns you when you cross its edge, setting you up for follow-up attacks. If you’re trapped inside, don’t run into the edge; move around inside and wait for it to disappear. Dodge Veigar W Dark Matter sideways after watching its ground indicator, and if you’re below half health, get out of range of Veigar R Primordial Burst.

Vex.build: Yone gets stronger with attack speed and critical strike chance, so build toward those stats. Magic resistance counters Vex’s main damage; also consider movement speed to dodge area attacks and tenacity to deal with fear.
Vex.combo: For an all-in, first activate Yone E Soul Unbound from a safe position, then engage with your prepared Yone Q Mortal Steel tornado and deal damage in this order: basic attack → Yone W Spirit Cleave → Yone R Fate Sealed → basic attack. Recast E to return after dealing damage. Delay the tornado engage if Vex’s fear is ready.
Vex.escape: The moment Vex P Doom 'n Gloom’s fear is used on the wave or to poke is your window to dash in.
Vex.fight: Look for a chance when Vex P Doom 'n Gloom’s fear is down and Vex W Personal Space has also been used. Hit minions with Yone Q Mortal Steel to prepare your tornado, then engage, and use Yone W Spirit Cleave’s shield when Vex’s key ability comes in.
Vex.laning: Repeatedly using Q pushes the wave, so use it less to pull the lane toward you and save Yone E Soul Unbound when you don’t know where the enemy jungler is. If Vex pushes the lane and uses her fear, try to trade with your prepared tornado.
Vex.phase: After building attack speed and critical strike chance and completing your first core item, take the initiative when Vex’s fear and shield are down. In late-game team fights, find an engage angle that lets you return with Yone E Soul Unbound.
Vex.teamfight: Use Yone E Soul Unbound to enter the back line, and hit multiple enemies with Yone W Spirit Cleave to build a larger shield. Aim Yone R Fate Sealed to pull enemies toward your team, and avoid angles that carry you through them and leave you deep in their formation. Allies marked by Vex R Shadow Surge should move toward your team, and get low-health allies out of Vex’s range to prevent her from chaining kills.
Vex.watch: While Vex P Doom 'n Gloom’s fear is ready, don’t dash in with Yone Q Mortal Steel tornado or Yone E Soul Unbound. If the Gloom mark appears after you dash, get outside Vex’s basic attack range and wait for it to disappear. Vex E Looming Darkness grows larger the farther it travels, so if you’re within range, dodge a short distance sideways instead of running far backward.

Viktor.build: Viktor’s damage is magic, so choose magic resistance if you need defenses. Movement speed is also useful for walking out of Viktor W Gravity Field.
Viktor.combo: Hit minions with Yone Q Mortal Steel to prepare your tornado, and activate Yone E Soul Unbound when Viktor W Gravity Field is down. Engage with tornado Q and deal damage in this order: basic attack, Yone W Spirit Cleave, Yone R Fate Sealed, basic attack; then recast E to return. Use R in a direction that won’t carry you past Viktor and leave you in danger.
Viktor.escape: Once Viktor W Gravity Field is down, it’s a good window to close the distance with Yone E Soul Unbound. If W is still available, you can be stunned inside W Gravity Field, so don’t dive in with E there. Viktor has no dash, so close the distance with Yone Q Mortal Steel or Yone R Fate Sealed while dodging his area.
Viktor.fight: Hit minions with Yone Q Mortal Steel to prepare your tornado, then engage when Viktor W Gravity Field is down or you can avoid its area. Time Yone W Spirit Cleave’s shield to absorb Viktor E Hextech Ray, deal a short burst of damage, then back off.
Viktor.laning: Don’t stand where Viktor E Hextech Ray can easily hit you along with the minions. When you don’t know where the enemy jungler is, don’t keep pushing the wave with Q; save Yone E Soul Unbound.
Viktor.phase: Yone gains the strength to take the initiative after completing his first core item. Viktor’s growth stacks are permanent, so he gets stronger over time; if his augment state changes, don’t assume previous trade results still apply.
Viktor.teamfight: Activate Yone E Soul Unbound, avoid Viktor W Gravity Field, and approach Viktor in the back line. Yone W Spirit Cleave’s shield grows when it hits multiple enemies, so use it toward the group. Choose a direction for Yone R Fate Sealed that pulls enemies toward your team, and save it if the path would leave you deep in their formation.
Viktor.watch: Viktor E Hextech Ray travels in a straight line, so don’t stand in line with minions; dodge sideways. When Viktor W Gravity Field is placed, leave it immediately instead of continuing to trade inside and risk being stunned. Also leave the area where Viktor R Arcane Storm is placed.

Vladimir.build: Vladimir’s main damage is magic, so build magic resistance early. Then build attack speed and critical strike core items. If his healing can turn a duel around, buy Executioner's Calling between core items and upgrade it to Mortal Reminder. Blade of The Ruined King, which deals damage based on maximum health, is also effective against Vladimir when he has stacked a lot of health.
Vladimir.combo: Hit minions with Yone Q Mortal Steel to prepare your tornado, and knock Vladimir up with tornado Q after Vladimir W Sanguine Pool is down. Follow with two basic attacks, Yone W Spirit Cleave, and another basic attack, then back off. For an all-in, activate Yone E Soul Unbound first, then land tornado Q, a basic attack, W, Yone R Fate Sealed, and a basic attack before returning with E.
Vladimir.escape: The moment Vladimir W Sanguine Pool is down is your chance to engage. Hit him with Yone Q Mortal Steel’s tornado or Yone R Fate Sealed as the pool ends. If you used Yone E Soul Unbound to engage, deal damage and return to your starting position.
Vladimir.fight: Hit minions with Yone Q Mortal Steel to prepare your tornado, then take a short trade. Back off if Vladimir Q Transfusion is empowered or you’re infected by Vladimir R Hemoplague.
Vladimir.laning: When you don’t know where the enemy jungler is, pull the lane toward you and save Yone E Soul Unbound.
Vladimir.phase: Use early pressure to slow Vladimir’s growth before his health and ability power increase over time.
Vladimir.teamfight: Spread out so multiple allies aren’t hit by Vladimir R Hemoplague, and if infected, engage after its effect ends. When diving deep, activate Yone E Soul Unbound first, and hit multiple enemies with Yone W Spirit Cleave to build a larger shield. Aim Yone R Fate Sealed to pull enemies toward your team, and look for a chance to hit Vladimir after W Sanguine Pool is down.
Vladimir.watch: When Vladimir Q Transfusion is empowered, avoid trading with its healing and movement speed increase in mind. If Vladimir charges E Tides of Blood, put minions between you or move out of range. If you’re infected by Vladimir R Hemoplague, you take increased damage, so re-engage after the effect ends.

Volibear.build: Completing your first core item is when Yone’s power rises, so prioritize building attack speed and critical strike chance. Build armor first for defenses against Volibear’s main damage from Q Thundering Smash, W Frenzied Maul, and R Stormbringer. If the healing from Volibear W Frenzied Maul can turn a duel around, buy Executioner's Calling between core items and upgrade it to Mortal Reminder.
Volibear.combo: For a short trade after Volibear Q Thundering Smash is down, prepare Yone Q Mortal Steel tornado on minions, then hit in this order: tornado Q → two basic attacks → Yone W Spirit Cleave → basic attack, then back off. For a decisive all-in, activate Yone E Soul Unbound first, then land tornado Q → basic attack → Yone W Spirit Cleave → Yone R Fate Sealed → basic attack, and recast E to return. Time Yone W Spirit Cleave’s shield to absorb Volibear E Sky Splitter as it comes in.
Volibear.escape: Engage when Volibear Q Thundering Smash’s stun is down and Volibear R Stormbringer is unavailable. If only Q is down, he can escape with R, so don’t chase recklessly. When engaging with Yone E Soul Unbound, account for the fact that strong crowd control can prevent you from returning right away.
Volibear.fight: Hit minions with Yone Q Mortal Steel to prepare your tornado, but don’t engage first with it while Volibear Q Thundering Smash’s stun is available. Dodge Volibear E Sky Splitter sideways by watching its indicator, and time Yone W Spirit Cleave’s shield to absorb his key damage. If Volibear has built attack speed stacks from passive P The Relentless Storm, delay the trade and engage after the stacks fall off.
Volibear.laning: Repeatedly using Q pushes the lane, so use it less to pull the lane toward you and save Yone E Soul Unbound when you don’t know where the enemy jungler is. Even if Volibear pushes the lane and gives you an angle to engage with tornado, trade only after Volibear Q Thundering Smash is down.
Volibear.phase: Once your first core item gives you attack speed and critical strike chance, it’s time for Yone to take the initiative. The available information doesn’t establish who has the advantage late game, so focus on engaging with Yone E Soul Unbound and returning alive in team fights.
Volibear.teamfight: If Volibear has fully stacked passive P The Relentless Storm, don’t immediately take the fight; wait for the stacks to fall off. Engage with Yone E Soul Unbound active and hit multiple enemies with Yone W Spirit Cleave to build a larger shield. Aim Yone R Fate Sealed to pull enemies toward your team, and save it if the path would leave you deep in their formation. If Volibear R Stormbringer is available, don’t assume low health under your turret is safe.
Volibear.watch: Volibear Q Thundering Smash increases his movement speed so he can chase and stun you, so when you see him activate it, stay outside basic attack range and let it run out. When you see the indicator for Volibear E Sky Splitter, move sideways to avoid its damage and slow. Volibear can heal with W Frenzied Maul, so don’t chase recklessly just because health has decreased. If Volibear R Stormbringer is available, don’t stay under your turret at low health.

Xerath.build: First complete your core item toward attack speed and critical strike chance. Choose magic resistance if you need defenses against Xerath’s damage. However, first consider ways to avoid or escape a situation where Xerath E Shocking Orb stuns you and you take repeated damage.
Xerath.combo: Hit minions with Yone Q Mortal Steel to prepare your tornado, then activate Yone E Soul Unbound after Xerath E Shocking Orb is down. Knock him up with Yone Q Mortal Steel tornado and deal damage in this order: basic attack, Yone W Spirit Cleave, Yone R Fate Sealed, basic attack; then recast Yone E Soul Unbound to return. For a short trade, engage with tornado, land two basic attacks and Yone W Spirit Cleave, then back off.
Xerath.escape: Xerath has no mobility, so the moment Xerath E Shocking Orb and W Eye of Destruction are down is your window to go in. In particular, if Xerath E Shocking Orb is still available, delay your engage because its stun may stop you from returning with Yone E Soul Unbound. If Xerath is casting R Rite of the Arcane, you can engage while he can’t move.
Xerath.fight: Hit minions with Yone Q Mortal Steel to prepare your tornado, but engage after Xerath E Shocking Orb is down. If Xerath W Eye of Destruction is down too, that’s a chance to close the distance and trade. Dodge sideways and close in while Xerath charges Q Arcanopulse.
Xerath.laning: Farm while avoiding Xerath’s heavy damage and wait for him to run low on mana; then push the lane and call your jungler. When you don’t know where the enemy jungler is, don’t keep pushing the wave with Yone Q Mortal Steel; save Yone E Soul Unbound.
Xerath.phase: When Xerath runs low on mana, push the lane and create an opportunity with your jungler. After Yone completes his first core item, take the initiative in a window when Xerath’s stun is down.
Xerath.teamfight: Activate Yone E Soul Unbound and pressure the back line where Xerath is, then return after dealing damage. Hit multiple champions with Yone W Spirit Cleave to build a larger shield. Aim Yone R Fate Sealed to pull enemies toward your team, and save it if the angle would carry you through several enemies and leave you deep in their formation.
Xerath.watch: Xerath Q Arcanopulse pierces minions, so when you see him charging, change direction and dodge sideways. If you’re stunned by Xerath E Shocking Orb, you’re likely to take follow-up damage, so don’t engage first with Yone Q Mortal Steel tornado or Yone E Soul Unbound while that ability is available. Time Yone W Spirit Cleave’s shield to absorb Xerath W Eye of Destruction as it comes in.

Yasuo.build: If you need defenses, build armor first against the physical damage from Yasuo Q Steel Tempest and Yasuo R Last Breath. Armor doesn’t mitigate the magic damage from Yasuo E Sweeping Blade.
Yasuo.combo: Hit minions with Yone Q Mortal Steel to prepare your tornado, and break Yasuo P Way of the Wanderer’s shield first. For an all-in, deal damage in this order: Yone E Soul Unbound → Yone Q Mortal Steel tornado → basic attack → Yone W Spirit Cleave → Yone R Fate Sealed → basic attack. Then recast Yone E Soul Unbound to return to your starting position.
Yasuo.escape: Right after Yasuo throws his Q Steel Tempest tornado, his knockup stacks reset, so look to engage. Don’t go in just because Yasuo E Sweeping Blade is down. Before Yasuo R Last Breath is available again, close the distance with prepared crowd control from Yone Q Mortal Steel or Yone R Fate Sealed.
Yasuo.fight: First trigger Yasuo P Way of the Wanderer’s shield with light poke, then take a full trade. The moment after Yasuo throws his Q Steel Tempest tornado is your chance to engage, so knock him up with your prepared Yone Q Mortal Steel tornado and land basic attacks two at a time. Use Yone W Spirit Cleave’s shield to absorb Yasuo’s key attack.
Yasuo.laning: Repeatedly using Q pushes the lane, so use it less and save Yone E Soul Unbound when you don’t know where the enemy jungler is. Keeping a thin wave near your side reduces the minions Yasuo E Sweeping Blade can use as stepping stones.
Yasuo.phase: Start taking the initiative once you complete your first core item and gain attack speed and critical strike chance. There’s no basis to determine who has the advantage late game, so fight in team fights while securing a place to return to with Yone E Soul Unbound.
Yasuo.teamfight: Activate Yone E Soul Unbound, disrupt the back line, and hit multiple enemies with Yone W Spirit Cleave to build a larger shield. Aim Yone R Fate Sealed to pull enemies toward your team, and avoid angles that carry you through several enemies and leave you deep in their formation. Return with Yone E Soul Unbound after dealing damage.
Yasuo.watch: Yasuo Q Steel Tempest has a narrow hit area, so move sideways to dodge when he approaches. If he lands it twice and has a tornado ready, watch for the knockup; if you have to fight, time Yone W Spirit Cleave’s shield to absorb his key attack. Yasuo E Sweeping Blade uses minions as stepping stones to approach, so watch the nearby wave too.

Yorick.build: Build armor first against Yorick Q Last Rites and the Mist Walkers’ physical damage. Yone’s power rises significantly starting with his first core item, which gives attack speed and critical strike chance. If the healing from Yorick Q Last Rites can turn a duel around, buy Executioner's Calling between core items and upgrade it to Mortal Reminder.
Yorick.combo: Hit minions with Yone Q Mortal Steel to prepare your tornado. If Yorick E Mourning Mist misses and Yorick W Dark Procession is down, activate Yone E Soul Unbound first, then knock him up with tornado Q and deal damage in this order: basic attack, Yone W Spirit Cleave, Yone R Fate Sealed, basic attack. Recast Yone E Soul Unbound to return to your starting position.
Yorick.escape: Yorick has no mobility, so the moment Yorick E Mourning Mist misses and Yorick W Dark Procession is down is your chance to engage. Don’t dive deep with Yone E Soul Unbound where Yorick W Dark Procession is still available.
Yorick.fight: Dodge Yorick E Mourning Mist and engage when Yorick W Dark Procession is down. Before trading, hit minions with Yone Q Mortal Steel to prepare your tornado, clear the Mist Walkers first, then take a short trade. Yorick has no mobility ability to create distance, so when an engage angle opens, close the distance with Yone E Soul Unbound and tornado Q.
Yorick.laning: When Yorick clears the wave on his side, graves build up, so when you can safely push, let minions die under Yorick’s turret. When you don’t know where the enemy jungler is, don’t push the lane by farming with Q; keep it pulled toward you and save Yone E Soul Unbound.
Yorick.phase: In the mid game, start taking the initiative from the point you complete your first core item with attack speed and critical strike chance. The available information doesn’t establish who has the advantage late game.
Yorick.watch: Yorick E Mourning Mist slows, marks, and deals damage based on maximum health, so dodge the path of the projectile. If trapped in Yorick W Dark Procession, hit the wall to break it or cross over with a prepared Yone Q Mortal Steel tornado. If the Maiden of the Mist starts attacking you, create distance from Yorick himself, and don’t start a fight where there are many Mist Walkers.

Zed.build: Build armor early to defend against the main damage from Zed Q Razor Shuriken, Zed E Shadow Slash, and Zed R Death Mark. Zed P Contempt for the Weak deals magic damage based on your maximum health, so armor alone cannot block all his damage.
Zed.combo: Hit minions with Yone Q Mortal Steel to prepare a tornado. To engage, deal damage in this order: Yone E Soul Unbound → tornado Q Mortal Steel → basic attack → Yone W Spirit Cleave → Yone R Fate Sealed → basic attack. Then recast E Soul Unbound to return. Check whether Zed W Living Shadow and Zed R Death Mark are still available, since he can use them to escape.
Zed.escape: Look to engage after Zed W Living Shadow's shadow disappears or after Zed has already repositioned. If Zed R Death Mark is still on cooldown, Yone Q Mortal Steel, Yone E Soul Unbound, and Yone R Fate Sealed give you a chance to close the distance. If only one of Zed's mobility spells is down, account for him escaping with the other.
Zed.fight: Hit minions with Yone Q Mortal Steel to prepare a tornado, then trade after Zed W Living Shadow is down. If Zed R Death Mark is still on cooldown, activate Yone E Soul Unbound before going in, deal damage, then return.
Zed.laning: Repeatedly using Q pushes the lane, so when you don't know where the enemy jungler is, use Q to farm less, let the lane push toward you, and hold Yone E Soul Unbound. If Zed has pushed the lane and used Zed W Living Shadow, look for a trade with your prepared tornado Q.
Zed.phase: Once you have attack speed and critical strike chance and have completed your first core item, you can take fights proactively. Zed peaks in the mid game and gets weaker as the game goes on, so don't give him an early lead and group with your allies in the late game.
Zed.teamfight: Use Yone E Soul Unbound to pressure the backline while securing a spot to return to. Hit multiple enemies with Yone W Spirit Cleave to build a larger shield. Cast Yone R Fate Sealed to pull enemies toward your allies, and hold it if the angle would send you deep into the enemy formation after passing through several enemies.
Zed.watch: Watch where Zed W Living Shadow is placed and move outside the slow radius of Zed E Shadow Slash. If Zed R Death Mark is applied, interrupt his combo with Yone Q Mortal Steel's knock-up or Yone R Fate Sealed before he can deal more damage. The mark's detonation deals all its damage at once, so time Yone W Spirit Cleave's shield to absorb it.

Zoe.build: Build magic resistance rather than armor to defend against Zoe's damage. However, Zoe E Sleepy Trouble Bubble reduces your magic resistance and also deals true damage, so avoiding the sleep takes priority.
Zoe.combo: Hit minions with Yone Q Mortal Steel to prepare a tornado, then knock Zoe up with tornado Q and trade in this order: two basic attacks → Yone W Spirit Cleave → basic attack. For a deeper engage, activate Yone E Soul Unbound first, then deal damage with tornado Q → basic attack → W → Yone R Fate Sealed → basic attack, and recast E to return. Don't rush this engage while Zoe E Sleepy Trouble Bubble is available.
Zoe.escape: Right after Zoe E Sleepy Trouble Bubble is down, you have a window to close the distance with Yone Q Mortal Steel or Yone E Soul Unbound. If Zoe uses R, aim for the spot where she started, which is where she returns.
Zoe.fight: Hit minions with Yone Q Mortal Steel to prepare a tornado, then engage when Zoe E Sleepy Trouble Bubble is down. When Zoe throws Zoe Q Paddle Star! to line up a shot, you can interrupt her redirecting it with Yone Q Mortal Steel's knock-up. If Zoe uses Zoe R Portal Jump, target her starting position, where she returns.
Zoe.laning: Repeatedly using Q pushes the lane, so when you don't know where the enemy jungler is, use Q less to let the lane push toward you and hold Yone E Soul Unbound. If Zoe has pushed the lane and her bubble is down, trade with your prepared tornado Q.
Zoe.phase: Even in the late game, check for Zoe's bubble first and choose an engage that lets you return with Yone E Soul Unbound.
Zoe.teamfight: After Zoe E Sleepy Trouble Bubble is down, activate Yone E Soul Unbound and approach Zoe in the backline. Hit multiple champions with Yone W Spirit Cleave to build a larger shield, and cast Yone R Fate Sealed to pull enemies toward your allies. Avoid an R angle that passes through several enemies and sends you deep into their formation, then return with E.
Zoe.watch: If Zoe E Sleepy Trouble Bubble hits you, you'll fall asleep shortly afterward, increasing the risk of being hit by Zoe Q Paddle Star!. If the bubble hits, move behind a wall or an ally before the sleep triggers to get out of Zoe Q Paddle Star!'s angle and range. A bubble that misses also leaves a trap, so be careful in narrow paths without vision.
